```{r paths, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# Single source of truth for paths. The project root is RHD_REPO_ROOT when set
# (rendering a copy outside the repository), else the folder above this .Rmd that
# holds scripts/00_run_all.R, else the project's known location. This report
# READS the pipeline's persisted output artifacts only -- it never re-runs any
# pipeline script and never writes into the repository.
find_repo_root <- function() {
  env <- Sys.getenv("RHD_REPO_ROOT")
  if (nzchar(env)) return(normalizePath(env, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
  d <- tryCatch(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), error = function(e) getwd())
  d <- normalizePath(d, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(d, "scripts", "00_run_all.R")) &&
        file.exists(file.path(d, "R", "abcd_engine.R"))) return(d)
    up <- dirname(d)
    if (identical(up, d)) break
    d <- up
  }
  fb <- "C:/Users/wrgar/OneDrive - UW/02Work/WorldBank-Indonesia/uw-wb-indonesia-rhd"
  if (dir.exists(fb)) return(fb)
  stop("Cannot find the repository root (folder holding scripts/00_run_all.R). Set RHD_REPO_ROOT.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
wd <- paste0(find_repo_root(), "/")

# COUNTRY drives which country's artifacts are read; mirrors 00_run_all.R's
# COUNTRY-scoped data/ and output/ layout. Guarded for chunk-by-chunk runs where
# `params` is absent. Set via rmarkdown::render(params = list(country = "Uganda")).
CTRY <- if (exists("params") && !is.null(params$country)) params$country else "Indonesia"

wd_data <- paste0(wd, "data/",   CTRY, "/")  # processed inputs, calibration bundle, baseline state (02-05)
wd_outp <- paste0(wd, "output/", CTRY, "/")  # model outputs (06) + tables (07/08)
wd_raw  <- paste0(wd, "data-raw/")           # shared raw inputs (legacy GBD copy only)
```

```{r helpers, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Required / optional artifacts -------------------------------------------
# A missing REQUIRED artifact stops the render with the script that produces it;
# nothing is substituted (no older output, prior, zero or other country).
need <- function(path, script) {
  if (!file.exists(path))
    stop("Missing required artifact:\n  ", path, "\n  Produced by scripts/", script,
         " (run scripts/00_run_all.R with COUNTRY = \"", CTRY, "\").",
         "\n  This report reads saved outputs only and never re-runs the pipeline.", call. = FALSE)
  path
}
# Saved-output consistency check: stops with the files involved and the upstream fix.
check <- function(ok, msg, files, fix) {
  if (!isTRUE(ok))
    stop("Saved-output consistency check failed: ", msg,
         "\n  Files: ", paste(files, collapse = "; "),
         "\n  Upstream regeneration needed: ", fix, call. = FALSE)
  invisible(TRUE)
}
not_saved <- function(what) cat(sprintf("*%s is not available in the saved outputs.*\n\n", what))

# ---- Number / currency formatters -------------------------------------------
fmt_n   <- function(x, d = 0) formatC(round(x, d), format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
fmt_m   <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
fmt_k   <- function(x, d = 0) formatC(x / 1e3, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
fmt_f   <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d)
fmt_pct <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%")
fmt_usd <- function(x, d = 0) paste0("$", formatC(round(x, d), format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ","))
usd_b   <- function(x, d = 2) paste0("$", formatC(x / 1e9, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ","), " billion")
usd_m   <- function(x, d = 1) paste0("$", formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ","), " million")
fmt_sig <- function(x, s = 3) formatC(signif(x, s), format = "fg", digits = s, flag = "#")
fmt_e   <- function(x, d = 1) formatC(x, format = "e", digits = d)
# "US$" inside prose can pair with another "$" and be parsed as inline math.
no_dollar <- function(x) gsub("US$", "US dollars", x, fixed = TRUE)

# Ratio relative to one, in words ("15% below", "8% above", "within 1% of").
rel_phrase <- function(r, d = 0, tol = 0.01) {
  if (length(r) != 1 || !is.finite(r)) return("not comparable with")
  if (abs(r - 1) < tol) return(paste0("within ", fmt_pct(tol, 0), " of"))
  paste0(fmt_pct(abs(r - 1), d), if (r < 1) " below" else " above")
}
# Scale-up relative to reference, in words ("12.3% lower", "essentially unchanged").
chg_phrase <- function(new, old, d = 1, tol = 5e-5) {
  if (length(old) != 1 || !is.finite(old) || old == 0) return("not defined (zero reference value)")
  r <- new / old - 1
  if (abs(r) < tol) return("essentially unchanged")
  paste0(fmt_pct(abs(r), d), if (r < 0) " lower" else " higher")
}
# Calibration parameters are stored on an unconstrained scale (logit for
# probabilities, log otherwise); bounds are mapped back for display.
par_scale <- function(nm, x) if (grepl("^p_", nm)) plogis(x) else exp(x)

# ---- GBD single-year-age -> GBD-group label (mirrors 03/04/04b age_to_gbd_group)
age_to_grp <- function(a) {
  fcase(
    a < 1,  "<1 year",
    a < 2,  "12-23 months",
    a < 5,  "2-4 years",
    a < 10, "5-9 years",
    a < 15, "10-14 years", a < 20, "15-19 years", a < 25, "20-24 years",
    a < 30, "25-29 years", a < 35, "30-34 years", a < 40, "35-39 years",
    a < 45, "40-44 years", a < 50, "45-49 years", a < 55, "50-54 years",
    a < 60, "55-59 years", a < 65, "60-64 years", a < 70, "65-69 years",
    a < 75, "70-74 years", a < 80, "75-79 years", a < 85, "80-84 years",
    a < 90, "85-89 years", a < 95, "90-94 years",
    default = "95+ years"
  )
}

```{r load-model-output, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Per-location model outputs written by 06_run_prevention_model.R --------
# One file per location: output/<COUNTRY>/out_model/<location>.rds, each a list
# with $wsd (aggregate well-sick-dead view, sick = A + B + C + D at year end,
# before ageing), $stages (start and end stocks, every flow, the surgery-service
# trace, cascade coverages and the SAP trace), $diag and $meta.
out_model_path <- paste0(wd_outp, "out_model/")
mfiles <- list.files(out_model_path, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(mfiles) == 0)
  stop("Missing required artifact: no model outputs in\n  ", out_model_path,
       "\n  Produced by scripts/06_run_prevention_model.R (run scripts/00_run_all.R with COUNTRY = \"",
       CTRY, "\").", call. = FALSE)

mods  <- lapply(mfiles, readRDS)
wsd   <- rbindlist(lapply(mods, function(m) as.data.table(m$wsd)),    use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
stg   <- rbindlist(lapply(mods, function(m) as.data.table(m$stages)), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
meta  <- mods[[1]]$meta
diag1 <- mods[[1]]$diag

wsd <- wsd[scenario %in% scenario_levels]
stg <- stg[scenario %in% scenario_levels]
wsd[, scenario := factor(scenario, levels = scenario_levels)]
stg[, scenario := factor(scenario, levels = scenario_levels)]

# ---- Key dimensions (read entirely from the saved run) ----------------------
LOCS        <- sort(unique(as.character(wsd$location)))
n_loc       <- length(LOCS)
year_min    <- min(wsd$year); year_max <- max(wsd$year)
base_year   <- meta$base_year                       # first analysis year (seed entering it)
ramp_start  <- meta$ramp_start; ramp_end <- meta$ramp_end
analysis_years <- sort(unique(as.integer(wsd$year)))
proj_years  <- paste0(year_min, "–", year_max)
sim_horizon <- proj_years
CAUSE       <- unique(as.character(wsd$cause))[1]
scenarios_present <- levels(droplevels(wsd$scenario))
```

```{r load-calib, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Calibration bundle written by 04 (Layer 1) and 04b (Layer 2) ------------
calib_path <- need(paste0(wd_data, "calibrated_rhd_parameters.rds"),
                   "04_calibration_random_tp.R and 04b_calibrate_structural.R")
calibb <- readRDS(calib_path)
L1  <- calibb$layer1
SC  <- calibb$stage_calibration
BP  <- SC$best_parameters
EDA <- SC$excess_death_attribution
OC  <- SC$objective_components
if (is.null(SC$status) || grepl("^FAILED", as.character(SC$status)) || is.null(BP))
  stop("The saved Layer-2 calibration is not usable (status '", as.character(SC$status), "'):\n  ",
       calib_path, "\n  Fix and re-run scripts/04b_calibrate_structural.R, then 05 -> 08.", call. = FALSE)

SPEC     <- SC$spec
D_ONLY   <- identical(SPEC$mortality_structure, "D_only")
PROG     <- identical(SPEC$sap_mechanism, "progression")
PREV_OBS <- if (!is.null(SPEC$prev_obs)) SPEC$prev_obs else OC$prev_obs_convention
cal_y0   <- as.integer(calibb$meta$calib_year_start)
cal_y1   <- as.integer(calibb$meta$calib_year_end)
match_from <- as.integer(OC$match_from)
death_floor <- if (is.null(OC$death_target_age_min)) 0L else as.integer(OC$death_target_age_min)
w_struct <- OC$weights
ptab     <- as.data.table(SC$parameters)
age_cut  <- BP$age_structure$adult_age_cutoff
prev_obs_label <- switch(PREV_OBS,
  mid   = "the mean of the start-of-year and end-of-year (pre-ageing) stocks",
  start = "the start-of-year stock",
  end   = "the end-of-year (pre-ageing) stock")
```

```{r load-baseline-state, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Baseline state assembled by 05_build_baseline.R ------------------------
bs_path <- need(paste0(wd_data, "baseline_state.rds"), "05_build_baseline.R")
bstate  <- readRDS(bs_path)
loc1    <- bstate$locations[1]
bst     <- bstate$states[[loc1]]
tr      <- bst$transitions        # child / reference-age scalar annual probabilities
pdth    <- bst$p_rhd_death        # per-stage RHD-attributable death probabilities c(A,B,C,D)
eff     <- bst$effects            # SAP mechanism + pathway hazard ratios + surgery effects
srg     <- bst$surgery            # surgery-service fractions + coverage
cov     <- bst$coverage           # realised ref/sap cascade, adherence and surgery trajectories
cov_years <- bstate$meta$years
seed    <- bst$seed               # stocks ENTERING the first analysis year
seed_tot <- sum(seed$A + seed$B + seed$C + seed$D)
seed_share <- c(A = sum(seed$A), B = sum(seed$B), C = sum(seed$C), D = sum(seed$D)) / seed_tot

# Fixed standard population year for the age-standardised rates: the GBD rate
# reference year recorded with the baseline (not the model's first analysis year).
BASE_YEAR <- as.integer(bstate$meta$RATE_BASE_YEAR)
hr_vec <- c(A_to_B = eff$sap_hr_A_to_B, B_to_C = eff$sap_hr_B_to_C, C_to_D = eff$sap_hr_C_to_D)
c_ref0 <- cov$ref$eff_protection[1]; c_tgt <- max(cov$sap$eff_protection)
```

```{r load-stage-flow-tables, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Compiled stage + flow long tables from 07_make_outputs.R ---------------
# Optional: when present they are checked against $stages below; when absent the
# same quantities are derived from $stages of the same run.
stage_path <- paste0(wd_outp, "tables/rhd_stage_model_long.rds")
flow_path  <- paste0(wd_outp, "tables/rhd_annual_flows.rds")
have_stage_tab <- file.exists(stage_path)
have_flow_tab  <- file.exists(flow_path)

if (have_stage_tab) {
  stage_long <- as.data.table(readRDS(stage_path))
} else {
  stage_long <- melt(stg[, .(scenario, age, sex, year, location, pop, A, B, C, D)],
                     id.vars = c("scenario", "age", "sex", "year", "location", "pop"),
                     measure.vars = STAGES, variable.name = "stage", value.name = "cases")
  stage_long[, pop := NULL]
}
stage_long[, scenario := factor(as.character(scenario), levels = scenario_levels)]
stage_long[, stage := factor(as.character(stage), levels = STAGES)]

flows <- if (have_flow_tab) as.data.table(readRDS(flow_path)) else copy(stg)
flows[, scenario := factor(as.character(scenario), levels = scenario_levels)]
```

```{r integrity, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Saved-output consistency checks (input integrity, not expected results) --
f_cal <- basename(calib_path); f_bs <- basename(bs_path)
f_out <- paste0("out_model/", basename(mfiles)); f_er <- basename(er_path)
rerun_05 <- "re-run 05_build_baseline.R -> 06 -> 07 -> 08 (scripts/00_run_all.R) for this COUNTRY"

check(identical(LOCS, sort(as.character(bstate$locations))) && all(LOCS == loc1) &&
        identical(as.character(calibb$meta$location), loc1) && loc1 == CTRY,
      paste0("location differs across artifacts or from COUNTRY = ", CTRY),
      c(f_cal, f_bs, f_out), "re-run the pipeline for this COUNTRY")
check(setequal(scenarios_present, scenario_levels) && setequal(unique(as.character(stg$scenario)), scenario_levels),
      "scenarios are not exactly ref + sap", f_out, "re-run 06")
check(identical(analysis_years, as.integer(meta$years)) && identical(as.integer(cov_years), as.integer(meta$years)) &&
        identical(sort(as.integer(unique(incr$year))), analysis_years),
      "analysis years differ across model, baseline and economics", c(f_bs, f_out, f_er), rerun_05)
# specification: one mortality structure and SAP mechanism across 04b, 05 and 06
spec_set <- list(calibration = SPEC[c("mortality_structure", "sap_mechanism")],
                 baseline = bstate$meta[c("mortality_structure", "sap_mechanism")],
                 model = meta[c("mortality_structure", "sap_mechanism")],
                 model_diag = diag1[c("mortality_structure", "sap_mechanism")])
check(all(vapply(spec_set, function(s) identical(unname(unlist(s)), unname(unlist(spec_set$calibration))), logical(1))),
      paste("mortality structure / SAP mechanism differ:",
            paste(names(spec_set), vapply(spec_set, function(s) paste(unlist(s), collapse = "/"), ""), sep = "=", collapse = "; ")),
      c(f_cal, f_bs, f_out), rerun_05)
# calibrated parameters and analysis-start state are the ones the model ran
check(isTRUE(all.equal(unlist(tr), unlist(BP$transitions))) && isTRUE(all.equal(pdth, BP$p_rhd_death)),
      "baseline transitions / stage mortality differ from the calibrated best parameters", c(f_cal, f_bs), rerun_05)
if (!is.null(BP$initial_state))
  check(all(vapply(STAGES, function(s) isTRUE(all.equal(unname(seed[[s]]), unname(BP$initial_state[[s]]))), logical(1))),
        "the 06 seed differs from the 04b analysis-start state", c(f_cal, f_bs), rerun_05)
rc <- BP$reference_care_in_calibration
check(abs(rc$treatment_effective - cov$ref$eff_treatment[1]) < 1e-9 && abs(rc$adherence - cov$ref$adherence[1]) < 1e-9 &&
        abs(rc$surgery - cov$ref$surgery[1]) < 1e-9,
      "reference care used in the calibration differs from the reference arm", c(f_cal, f_bs), "re-run 04b -> 08")
# the model ran the baseline's coverage trajectories
cv_out <- stg[, .(tx = effective_treatment_coverage[1], adh = sap_adherence[1], srg = surgery_coverage[1]), keyby = .(scenario, year)]
cv_in  <- rbindlist(lapply(scenario_levels, function(s) data.table(scenario = s, year = cov_years,
            tx = cov[[s]]$eff_treatment, adh = cov[[s]]$adherence, srg = cov[[s]]$surgery)))
cv_cmp <- merge(cv_out[, scenario := as.character(scenario)], cv_in, by = c("scenario", "year"))
check(nrow(cv_cmp) == 2L * length(analysis_years) &&
        cv_cmp[, max(abs(tx.x - tx.y), abs(adh.x - adh.y), abs(srg.x - srg.y))] < 1e-9,
      "coverage/adherence in the model output differ from baseline_state", c(f_bs, f_out), "re-run 06 -> 08")
# structural identities of the run
check(merge(stg[, .(scenario, age, sex, year, s = A + B + C + D)], wsd[, .(scenario, age, sex, year, sick)],
              by = c("scenario", "age", "sex", "year"))[, max(abs(s - sick))] < 1e-6,
      "stages A-D do not sum to the aggregate RHD stock", f_out, "re-run 06")
pp_chk <- dcast(wsd[, .(pop = sum(pop)), by = .(scenario, year)], year ~ scenario, value.var = "pop")
check(max(abs(pp_chk$ref - pp_chk$sap)) < 1e-6, "arms do not share one population", f_out, "re-run 06")
if (D_ONLY)
  check(stg[, all(rhd_deaths_A == 0 & rhd_deaths_B == 0 & rhd_deaths_C == 0)] && all(pdth[c("A", "B", "C")] == 0),
        "D-only run has RHD deaths outside stage D", c(f_bs, f_out), rerun_05)
if (PROG)
  check(stg[, max(abs(eff_cf - 1))] < 1e-12 &&
          stg[, max(abs(sap_prog_mult_A_to_B - (1 - sap_effective_protection * (1 - hr_vec[["A_to_B"]]))),
                    abs(sap_prog_mult_B_to_C - (1 - sap_effective_protection * (1 - hr_vec[["B_to_C"]]))),
                    abs(sap_prog_mult_C_to_D - (1 - sap_effective_protection * (1 - hr_vec[["C_to_D"]]))))] < 1e-9,
        "progression-mode SAP trace does not match the saved hazard ratios", c(f_bs, f_out), rerun_05)
# economics computed from this model run (deaths and costs)
d_by <- dcast(wsd[, .(d = sum(dead)), by = .(scenario, year)], year ~ scenario, value.var = "d")
e_cmp <- merge(d_by, incr[, .(year, deaths_avert, cost_ref, cost_sap)], by = "year")
c_by <- stg[, .(cost = sum(n_screened) * eparams$cost_screen_per_person +
                       sum(n_on_optimal_treatment) * eparams$cost_sap_per_year +
                       sum(total_surgeries) * eparams$cost_surgery), by = .(scenario, year)]
c_by <- dcast(c_by, year ~ scenario, value.var = "cost")
e_cmp <- merge(e_cmp, c_by, by = "year", suffixes = c("", "_recalc"))
check(nrow(e_cmp) == length(analysis_years) && e_cmp[, max(abs((ref - sap) - deaths_avert))] < 1e-6 &&
        e_cmp[, max(abs(ref_recalc - cost_ref) / pmax(abs(cost_ref), 1), abs(sap_recalc - cost_sap) / pmax(abs(cost_sap), 1))] < 1e-8,
      "the saved economics were not computed from this model run", c(f_out, f_er), "re-run 08_economic_evaluation.R")
check(econ_sum[location == loc1, abs(deaths_averted - sum(e_cmp$deaths_avert))] < 1e-6,
      "economic summary deaths averted differ from the incremental table", f_er, "re-run 08")
# programme volumes follow the saved screening schedule (outputs from before the
# screening-encounter revision stop here rather than being shown under it)
sched  <- cov$screen_schedule
enc_pp <- cov$screen_encounters_per_person
check(!is.null(sched) && !is.null(enc_pp) && !is.null(diag1$screening_by_year),
      "the saved baseline / model output predate the screening-encounter revision (no screening schedule)",
      c(f_bs, f_out), "re-run 03 -> 05 -> 06 -> 07 -> 08 (scripts/00_run_all.R) for this COUNTRY")
scr_chk <- stg[, .(enc = sum(n_screened), c = screen_coverage[1], w = sum(pop * enc_pp[as.character(age)])),
               by = .(scenario, year)]
check(scr_chk[, max(abs(enc - c * w) / pmax(enc, 1))] < 1e-9 &&
        stg[, max(abs(n_on_optimal_treatment - living_rhd_start * effective_treatment_coverage))] < 1e-6,
      "screening encounters or SAP person-years differ from the saved schedule / coverage definitions", f_out, "re-run 06 -> 08")
# economics use the GNI-anchored, VSL-only valuation (no additive GDP benefit)
check(!is.null(eparams$gni_pc_base) && all(incr$benefit_gdp == 0) &&
        isTRUE(all.equal(incr$benefit_total, incr$benefit_vsl)) &&
        max(abs(incr$vsl / (eparams$vsl_mult * eparams$gni_pc_base *
                            (1 + eparams$gdp_growth)^(incr$year - eparams$gni_pc_base_year)) - 1)) < 1e-10,
      "the saved economics predate the GNI-anchored, VSL-only valuation", f_er, "re-run 08_economic_evaluation.R")
# compiled 07 tables (optional) must come from the same run
if (have_stage_tab) {
  s7 <- stage_long[, .(n = sum(cases)), by = .(scenario, year, stage)]
  s6 <- melt(stg[, lapply(.SD, sum), by = .(scenario, year), .SDcols = STAGES], id.vars = c("scenario", "year"),
             variable.name = "stage", value.name = "n6")
  s6[, stage := factor(as.character(stage), levels = STAGES)]
  check(merge(s7, s6, by = c("scenario", "year", "stage"))[, max(abs(n - n6))] < 1e-6,
        "rhd_stage_model_long.rds differs from the model output", c("tables/rhd_stage_model_long.rds", f_out), "re-run 07_make_outputs.R")
}
if (have_flow_tab)
  check(abs(flows[, sum(total_surgeries)] - stg[, sum(total_surgeries)]) < 1e-6 &&
          abs(flows[, sum(C_to_D)] - stg[, sum(C_to_D)]) < 1e-6,
        "rhd_annual_flows.rds differs from the model output", c("tables/rhd_annual_flows.rds", f_out), "re-run 07_make_outputs.R")

# File modification order (reported; content checks above are authoritative)
prov_files <- c(`disease_model_inputs.rds (03)` = paste0(wd_data, "disease_model_inputs.rds"),
                `calibrated_rhd_parameters.rds (04/04b)` = calib_path,
                `baseline_state.rds (05)` = bs_path,
                `out_model (06)` = mfiles[1],
                `rhd_economic_results.rds (08)` = er_path)
prov_mtime <- vapply(prov_files, function(f) if (file.exists(f)) format(file.mtime(f), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") else NA_character_, "")
mt_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(file.mtime(prov_files[file.exists(prov_files)])))
mtime_ordered <- !is.unsorted(mt_num)

# Prevalence observed on the calibration's stored convention, for comparisons with
# GBD; the end-of-year stock ($wsd sick) is used for dated scenario results.
wsd <- merge(wsd, stg[, .(scenario, age, sex, year, living_rhd_start)],
             by = c("scenario", "age", "sex", "year"))
wsd[, prev_obs := switch(PREV_OBS, start = living_rhd_start, end = sick,
                         mid = 0.5 * (living_rhd_start + sick))]

```{r load-gbd, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- GBD 2023 epidemiology for the historical validation panels (optional) ---
gbd_try <- c(paste0(wd_data, "temp_baseline_rates_gbd.rds"),
             paste0(wd_raw,  "temp_baseline_rates_gbd.rds"))
gbd_path <- gbd_try[file.exists(gbd_try)][1]
have_gbd <- !is.na(gbd_path)
if (have_gbd) {
  gbd <- as.data.table(readRDS(gbd_path))
  gbd <- gbd[location_name == loc1]
  gbd_last <- max(gbd$year)
}

# Observed single-year WPP population (02; stable filename) for the observed period.
po_path <- paste0(wd_data, "pop_observed.rds")
have_pop <- file.exists(po_path)
if (have_pop) {
  pop_obs <- as.data.table(readRDS(po_path))
  pop_obs <- pop_obs[location == loc1]
  gbd_pop_yr <- pop_obs[, .(pop = sum(Nx)), by = year]
  pop_grp <- pop_obs[, .(pop = sum(Nx)), by = .(year, sex, grp = age_to_grp(age))]
} else {
  gbd_pop_yr <- NULL; pop_grp <- NULL
}

# GBD annual count on the calibration target basis: "rate_x_pop" = GBD Rate x WPP
# population of the same age-sex-year cell (the model's own denominator);
# "number" = published GBD Number. Returns data.table(year, count).
gbd_basis <- if (!is.null(SPEC$target_basis)) SPEC$target_basis else calibb$meta$layer2_target_basis
gbd_basis_label <- if (identical(gbd_basis, "number")) "GBD published Number" else "GBD rate × WPP population"
gbd_count_yr <- function(cause, measure) {
  if (!have_gbd) return(NULL)
  if (identical(gbd_basis, "number"))
    return(gbd[cause_name == cause & measure_name == measure & metric_name == "Number",
               .(count = sum(val)), by = year][order(year)])
  if (is.null(pop_grp)) return(NULL)
  r <- gbd[cause_name == cause & measure_name == measure & metric_name == "Rate",
           .(year, sex = sex_name, grp = age_name, rate = val / 1e5)]
  merge(r, pop_grp, by = c("year", "sex", "grp"))[, .(count = sum(rate * pop)), by = year][order(year)]
}
```

```{r headline-precompute, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# Cumulative flows over the horizon by scenario (deaths and incident cases are flows).
scn_flow <- wsd[, .(dead = sum(dead), inc = sum(newcases)), by = scenario]
deaths_ref <- scn_flow[scenario == "ref", dead]; deaths_sap <- scn_flow[scenario == "sap", dead]
inc_ref_cum <- scn_flow[scenario == "ref", inc]; inc_sap_cum <- scn_flow[scenario == "sap", inc]
deaths_averted_cum <- deaths_ref - deaths_sap
rel_deaths_cum <- if (deaths_ref > 0) deaths_averted_cum / deaths_ref else NA_real_
prev_end <- wsd[year == year_max, .(prev = sum(sick)), by = scenario]
prev_end_ref <- prev_end[scenario == "ref", prev]; prev_end_sap <- prev_end[scenario == "sap", prev]

tot <- econ_sum[location == "TOTAL"]
if (!nrow(tot)) tot <- econ_sum[.N]
bcr_hl     <- tot$bcr
netben_hl  <- tot$net_benefit
inccost_hl <- tot$total_cost
benefit_hl <- tot$total_benefit
cpd_hl     <- tot$cost_per_death
cpdaly_hl  <- tot$cost_per_daly
bcr_defined <- is.finite(bcr_hl) && is.finite(inccost_hl) && inccost_hl > 0
bcr_txt <- if (bcr_defined) fmt_f(bcr_hl) else
  paste0("not defined (", gsub("_", "-", tot$incremental_cost_status), ": non-positive discounted incremental cost)")

# ---- Revision bridge: the RETIRED definitions recomputed from THIS run ---------
# Health results are identical under every row (only volumes x prices and the
# valuation change). Retired screening = reach x whole population every year;
# retired valuation = deaths averted x (VSL on GDP per capita + one year of GDP pc).
vsl_b <- eparams$vsl_mult * eparams$gni_pc_base
scr_alt <- stg[, .(old = sum(pop * screen_coverage), new = sum(n_screened)), by = .(scenario, year)]
scr_alt <- dcast(scr_alt, year ~ scenario, value.var = c("old", "new"))
brg <- merge(scr_alt, incr[, .(year, df, deaths_avert, gdp_pc)], by = "year")
pvc_new <- tot$total_cost; pvb_new <- tot$total_benefit
pvc_old <- pvc_new + brg[, sum(df * eparams$cost_screen_per_person * ((old_sap - old_ref) - (new_sap - new_ref)))]
pvb_old <- brg[, sum(df * deaths_avert * (eparams$vsl_mult + 1) * gdp_pc)]
bridge <- data.table(
  row_id = c("prev", "screen", "value", "both"),
  Specification = c("Retired definitions: whole-population annual screening; VSL + one year of GDP per capita, both on GDP per capita",
                    "Screening correction only (scheduled encounters; retired valuation)",
                    "Valuation correction only (GNI-anchored VSL alone; retired screening volume)",
                    "Both corrections (saved run)"),
  cost = c(pvc_old, pvc_new, pvc_old, pvc_new), benefit = c(pvb_old, pvb_old, pvb_new, pvb_new))
bridge[, `:=`(net = benefit - cost, bcr = fifelse(cost > 0, benefit / cost, NA_real_))]
scr_pv <- brg[, c(old = sum(df * eparams$cost_screen_per_person * (old_sap - old_ref)),
                  new = sum(df * eparams$cost_screen_per_person * (new_sap - new_ref)))]
dir_word <- function(new, old) if (!is.finite(new) || !is.finite(old)) "changes (undefined ratio)" else
  if (new > old) "raises" else if (new < old) "lowers" else "leaves unchanged"

mech_txt <- if (PROG) "slowing progression between WHF stages (A → B, B → C and C → D)" else
  "lowering RHD-attributable mortality in every stage (legacy direct-mortality comparator)"
mort_txt <- if (D_ONLY) "RHD-attributable death occurs only from stage D" else
  "RHD-attributable death occurs from every stage, severity-ordered"
```

# Background

This report documents the **`r CTRY` rheumatic heart disease (RHD)
secondary-prevention investment-case model** and presents its calibration,
baseline, projected and economic outputs. It reads **only the pipeline's
persisted artifacts** — the calibration bundle and baseline state in
data/`r CTRY`/, the model output in output/`r CTRY`/out_model/, the economic
tables in output/`r CTRY`/tables/ and the GBD 2023 extract used for validation. It does **not** re-run any pipeline script; every number,
year, setting and direction of change in the text below is computed from those
files when the report is rendered.

RHD is an acquired valvular heart disease that follows acute rheumatic fever
after group A streptococcal infection and progresses, over years, from a minimal
(subclinical) valve lesion through advancing valve disease to complicated disease
with heart failure. The **secondary-prevention investment case** couples
**echocardiographic screening** and **diagnosis** with **secondary antibiotic
prophylaxis (SAP)** — long-acting penicillin that suppresses recurrent
streptococcal infection. In the saved run, SAP acts by **`r mech_txt`**, and
**`r mort_txt`**.

The central question is:

> *How many RHD deaths does scaling up echo screening and secondary antibiotic
> prophylaxis avert in `r CTRY` within the analysis horizon (`r proj_years`), and
> does the monetised benefit exceed the incremental cost?*

The engine is a **discrete-time, age × sex cohort model** whose living RHD
population is resolved into the four **World Heart Federation stages** — **A**
(minimal / early), **B** (mild established), **C** (advanced without
complications) and **D** (advanced with complications) — run once per arm:

- a **reference** (`ref`) arm, with the care cascade held at its baseline
  coverage, and
- a **SAP scale-up** (`sap`) arm, in which screening, diagnosis and optimal
  treatment rise to their targets between `r ramp_start` and `r ramp_end`.

The investment-case design follows Coates et al. (*Lancet Global Health* 2021),
adapted to the demography of `r CTRY`, to GBD 2023 epidemiology and to the WHF
A/B/C/D staging. Several structural choices — the D-only mortality structure, the
progression mechanism of SAP and its stage-specific effects — are **provisional
modelling assumptions** pending clinical review; they are flagged where they
appear.

```{r bg-inline, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
"Within the analysis horizon (%s), the saved scale-up run has **%s fewer RHD deaths**
than the reference arm (%s of reference-arm RHD deaths). ",
  proj_years, fmt_n(deaths_averted_cum), fmt_pct(rel_deaths_cum, 1)))
cat(sprintf(
"The discounted incremental cost is **%s** and the monetised benefit **%s**, giving a
**net benefit of %s** and a **benefit–cost ratio of %s** (cost per DALY averted %s).
Full economics are in the [economic evaluation](#economic-evaluation).",
  usd_b(inccost_hl), usd_b(benefit_hl), usd_b(netben_hl), bcr_txt,
  if (is.finite(cpdaly_hl)) fmt_usd(cpdaly_hl) else "not defined"))
```

> **A note on terminology.** *Deaths averted* means reference-arm minus
> scale-up-arm RHD deaths, summed within `r proj_years`. Because SAP here changes
> stage trajectories rather than removing anyone from risk, a death counted as
> averted inside the horizon may be deferred rather than permanently prevented;
> the horizon-bounded count does not distinguish the two. Prevalence is reported
> as a **dated stock** (people alive with RHD at a stated time), never as a sum
> over years.

# Model inputs

Every value below is read from the saved artifacts: natural-history, effect,
surgery and coverage values from `baseline_state.rds` (`$states[[loc]]`), prior
centres, bounds and provenance from `calibrated_rhd_parameters.rds`
(`$stage_calibration$parameters`, `$priors`, `$bounds`), and economic values
from `rhd_economic_results.rds$params`. Provenance tags: **[DATA]** observed
input; **[CALIBRATED]** estimated in Layer 2; **[STRUCTURAL]** a structural
modelling assumption; **[PROVISIONAL]** a provisional evidence mapping pending
review; **[ASSUMPTION]** a scenario assumption; **[DERIVED]** computed by the
pipeline; **[LIT]** / **[PAPER]** literature or article value as tagged in
`00_run_all.R`.

```{r tbl-inputs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
inp <- data.table(Group = character(), Parameter = character(), Value = character(),
                  `Prior centre [bounds]` = character(), Provenance = character())
add_row <- function(g, p, v, pr = "—", prov)
  inp <<- rbind(inp, data.table(Group = g, Parameter = p, Value = v,
                                `Prior centre [bounds]` = pr, Provenance = prov))
par_info <- function(nm, f) {
  r <- ptab[parameter == nm]
  if (!nrow(r)) return(list(value = NA_character_, prior = "—", bound = FALSE))
  list(value = f(r$value),
       prior = sprintf("%s [%s–%s]", f(r$prior_center), f(par_scale(nm, r$lower)), f(par_scale(nm, r$upper))),
       bound = isTRUE(r$at_lower) || isTRUE(r$at_upper))
}
f_p2 <- function(x) fmt_pct(x, 2); f_x3 <- function(x) fmt_f(x, 3)

g <- sprintf("Transitions (annual probability; child / reference age < %d)", age_cut)
for (nm in tr_names) {
  pinf <- par_info(nm, f_p2)
  if (is.na(pinf$value)) add_row(g, tr_label[[nm]], f_p2(tr[[nm]]), "fixed (not estimated)", "[ASSUMPTION]")
  else add_row(g, tr_label[[nm]], paste0(f_p2(tr[[nm]]), if (pinf$bound) " (at bound)" else ""), pinf$prior, "[CALIBRATED]")
}
g <- sprintf("Adult (age ≥ %d) hazard multipliers", age_cut)
pinf <- par_info("log_adult_prog_mult", f_x3)
add_row(g, "Progression hazards (A→B, B→C, C→D)", paste0(fmt_f(BP$age_structure$adult_prog_mult, 3), if (pinf$bound) " (at bound)" else ""),
        pinf$prior, if (isTRUE(BP$age_structure$calibrated)) "[CALIBRATED]" else "[ASSUMPTION]")
pinf <- par_info("log_adult_remission_mult", f_x3)
add_row(g, "Remission hazard (A → No RHD)", paste0(fmt_f(BP$age_structure$adult_remission_mult, 3), if (pinf$bound) " (at bound)" else ""),
        pinf$prior, if (isTRUE(BP$age_structure$calibrated)) "[CALIBRATED]" else "[ASSUMPTION]")

g <- "RHD-attributable mortality (annual probability, untreated natural history)"
if (D_ONLY) {
  for (s in c("A", "B", "C")) add_row(g, paste("Stage", s), "0 (exact)", "structural zero", "[STRUCTURAL]")
  pinf <- par_info("log_mD", function(x) fmt_pct(x, 2))
  add_row(g, "Stage D (m_D, one level for all ages and both sexes)",
          paste0(fmt_pct(pdth[["D"]], 2), if (pinf$bound) " (at bound)" else ""), pinf$prior, "[CALIBRATED; prior PROVISIONAL]")
  add_row(g, "Residual mortality multiplier", fmt_f(BP$residual_mortality_mult, 2), "fixed", "[STRUCTURAL]")
} else {
  for (s in STAGES) add_row(g, paste("Stage", s), fmt_pct(pdth[[s]], 3),
                            fmt_pct(SC$priors$mortality_centers[[s]], 3), "[CALIBRATED]")
  add_row(g, "Residual mortality multiplier", fmt_f(BP$residual_mortality_mult, 3),
          sprintf("1 [%s]", paste(SC$bounds$residual_mult, collapse = "–")), "[CALIBRATED]")
}

g <- sprintf("SAP effect (mechanism: %s)", SPEC$sap_mechanism)
if (PROG) {
  for (k in names(hr_vec))
    add_row(g, sprintf("Hazard ratio %s (full protection)", sub("_to_", " → ", k)),
            sprintf("%s (hazard −%s at target protection)", fmt_f(hr_vec[[k]], 3), fmt_pct(c_tgt * (1 - hr_vec[[k]]), 1)),
            "—", "[PROVISIONAL]")
  add_row(g, "Direct RHD-mortality RRR (legacy comparator)", paste0(fmt_pct(eff$sap_rrr_rhd_death, 0), " — not applied"), "—", "[LEGACY]")
} else {
  add_row(g, "Direct RHD-mortality RRR, all stages", fmt_pct(eff$sap_rrr_rhd_death, 0), "—", "[PROVISIONAL]")
}
g <- "Surgery effects (relative risk reduction at full reach)"
add_row(g, "Surgery on C → D progression", fmt_pct(eff$eff_surgery_C_to_D, 0), "—", "[LIT/CALIBRATE]")
add_row(g, "Surgery on stage-D RHD death", fmt_pct(eff$eff_surgery_D_to_rhd_death, 0), "—", "[LIT/CALIBRATE]")
g <- "Surgery service (per year)"
add_row(g, "Fraction of stage C requiring surgery", fmt_pct(srg$frac_C_requiring_surgery, 1), "—", "[CALIBRATE]")
add_row(g, "Fraction of stage D requiring surgery", fmt_pct(srg$frac_D_requiring_surgery, 1), "—", "[CALIBRATE]")
add_row(g, "Surgery coverage — reference / scale-up",
        sprintf("%s / %s", fmt_pct(cov$ref$surgery[1], 1), fmt_pct(cov$sap$surgery[1], 1)), "—", "[CALIBRATE]")

g <- "Care cascade and adherence"
add_row(g, sprintf("Screening reach (share of scheduled encounters delivered) — baseline → %d target", ramp_end),
        sprintf("%s → %s", fmt_pct(cov$ref$screen[1], 1), fmt_pct(max(cov$sap$screen), 0)), "—", "[PAPER]")
add_row(g, sprintf("Diagnosis — baseline → %d target", ramp_end),
        sprintf("%s → %s", fmt_pct(cov$ref$diagnosis[1], 1), fmt_pct(max(cov$sap$diagnosis), 0)), "—", "[PAPER]")
add_row(g, sprintf("SAP coverage (share of all prevalent RHD) — baseline → %d target", ramp_end),
        sprintf("%s → %s", fmt_pct(cov$ref$treatment[1], 2), fmt_pct(max(cov$sap$treatment), 0)), "—", "[PAPER]")
add_row(g, "Adherence modifier — reference arm (first → last year)",
        sprintf("%s → %s", fmt_f(cov$ref$adherence[1], 2), fmt_f(cov$ref$adherence[length(cov_years)], 2)), "—", "[ASSUMPTION]")
add_row(g, "Adherence modifier — scale-up arm (first → last year)",
        sprintf("%s → %s", fmt_f(cov$sap$adherence[1], 2), fmt_f(cov$sap$adherence[length(cov_years)], 2)), "—", "[ASSUMPTION]")
add_row(g, "Scale-up ramp window", sprintf("%d → %d", ramp_start, ramp_end), "—", "[ASSUMPTION]")

g <- "Screening schedule (annual encounters per person; both sexes, both arms)"
for (i in seq_len(nrow(sched)))
  add_row(g, sprintf("Ages %d–%d: %g screen%s across the %d-year window", sched$age_lo[i], sched$age_hi[i],
                     sched$n_screens[i], if (sched$n_screens[i] == 1) "" else "s", sched$window_years[i]),
          sprintf("%g/%d = %s", sched$n_screens[i], sched$window_years[i], fmt_f(sched$annual_multiplier[i], 4)), "—",
          if (sched$age_lo[i] == 5L && sched$age_hi[i] == 19L) "[WHO 2024 window; frequency ASSUMPTION]" else "[ASSUMPTION]")
add_row(g, sprintf("Ages outside %s", paste(sprintf("%d–%d", sched$age_lo, sched$age_hi), collapse = " and ")),
        "0 (no encounters)", "—", "[ASSUMPTION]")

g <- "Incidence and analysis-start state"
add_row(g, sprintf("Incidence secular trend (per year, anchored at %d)", bstate$meta$incidence_trend_anchor_year),
        fmt_f(bstate$meta$incidence_trend, 3), "—", "[ASSUMPTION]")
add_row(g, "Incidence source in the projection", bstate$meta$incidence_source, "—", "[CALIBRATED]")
add_row(g, sprintf("Living RHD entering %d (seed)", base_year), fmt_n(seed_tot), "—", "[DERIVED]")
add_row(g, sprintf("Seed stage shares A / B / C / D (%d)", base_year),
        paste(fmt_pct(seed_share, 1), collapse = " / "), "—", "[DERIVED]")

g <- "Economic parameters (08; US$)"
add_row(g, "Discount rate (costs & benefits)", fmt_pct(eparams$disc_rate, 1), "—", "[PAPER]")
add_row(g, sprintf("GNI per capita, Atlas method (%d) — VSL income anchor", eparams$gni_pc_base_year),
        fmt_usd(eparams$gni_pc_base), "—", "[DATA: World Bank WDI]")
add_row(g, "Value of a statistical life (× GNI per capita)", sprintf("%g×", eparams$vsl_mult), "—", "[PROVISIONAL]")
add_row(g, sprintf("VSL in %d (anchor year)", eparams$gni_pc_base_year), fmt_usd(vsl_b), "—", "[DERIVED]")
add_row(g, "Real per-capita GDP growth (carries VSL forward)", fmt_pct(eparams$gdp_growth, 1), "—", "[ASSUMPTION]")
add_row(g, "Undiscounted DALYs per RHD death", sprintf("%g", eparams$dalys_per_death), "—", "[CALIBRATE]")
add_row(g, "Echo screening cost / screening encounter", fmt_usd(eparams$cost_screen_per_person, 2), "—", "[PAPER]")

rl  <- rle(inp$Group)

# Realised cascade, adherence and effective protection per arm (from baseline_state).
metric_lab <- c(screen = "Screening reach (scheduled encounters delivered)", diagnosis = "Diagnosis",
                treatment = "SAP coverage (all prevalent RHD)",
                adherence = "Adherence modifier", eff_protection = "Effective protection (c)")
metric_col <- c(screen = "#4E79A7", diagnosis = "#59A14F", treatment = "#E15759",
                adherence = "#9C755F", eff_protection = "#222222")
covdt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(metric_lab), function(m)
  rbindlist(lapply(scenario_levels, function(s)
    data.table(year = cov_years, coverage = cov[[s]][[m]], metric = m, scenario = s)))))
covdt[, `:=`(metric = factor(metric, levels = names(metric_lab)),
             scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_levels))]
ggplot(covdt, aes(year, coverage, color = metric, linetype = metric)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = ramp_start, xmax = ramp_end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.08, fill = "#2166ac") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ scenario, labeller = as_labeller(scenario_labels_short)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metric_col, labels = metric_lab, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(screen = "solid", diagnosis = "solid", treatment = "solid",
                                   adherence = "dotted", eff_protection = "longdash"),
                        labels = metric_lab, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(title = "Realised care-cascade coverage, adherence and effective protection",
       subtitle = paste0("Shaded band = ramp window (", ramp_start, "-", ramp_end,
                         "); effective protection = min(reach, diagnosis, SAP coverage) x adherence"),
       x = "Year", y = "Coverage / modifier") +
  base_theme(12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2), linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```

These lines are **shares**, not volumes. Screening *reach* is the share of the
scheduled annual screening encounters that the programme delivers; it is not the
share of the population screened in a year. The encounter **volumes** that are
costed come from the screening schedule (Table 1) and are derived in
[programme volumes](#programme-volumes). SAP coverage is the share of **all**
living prevalent RHD, at any age, receiving SAP.

The adherence modifier is a population-average **relative attenuation** of
effective treatment coverage. A value of 1 means *no additional attenuation* of
the cascade's already effective, adherent "optimal treatment" coverage; it does
not mean universal treatment or an assumed improvement in adherence. In the
saved run adherence is `r if (all(abs(unlist(lapply(scenario_levels, function(s) cov[[s]]$adherence)) - 1) < 1e-12)) "1 in every year of both arms, so effective protection equals effective treatment coverage" else "not identically 1; the trajectories shown above apply"`.

# Methods

## Model structure

```{r fig-model-schematic, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.4, fig.cap=paste0("Figure M1. A/B/C/D state-transition structure of the saved run (", SPEC$mortality_structure, " mortality; SAP mechanism ", SPEC$sap_mechanism, "). Incident RHD enters stage A from the No-RHD pool. Solid arrows: progression and incidence; dashed purple arrows: regression/remission; red arrows: RHD-attributable death; grey: competing other-cause death, which applies to every state. Surgery is a service acting on C → D and stage-D death, not a state. Survivors age one year per cycle with an open 100+ group.")}
# Generated from the saved specification (replaces the static docs/ schematic,
# which predates the D-only / progression specification).
# Plot text uses ASCII only: the knitted PNG device drops arrow and minus glyphs.
pdc_active <- isTRUE(tr$p_D_to_C > 0)
sap_on <- function(lbl) if (PROG) paste0(lbl, "\nSAP lowers hazard") else lbl
nodes <- data.table(x = c(0.6, 2, 3.4, 4.8, 6.2, 7.6, 3.4), y = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, -0.2),
  lab = c("No RHD\n(susceptible)", "A\nminimal", "B\nmild", "C\nadvanced", "D\ncomplicated", "RHD\ndeath",
          "Other-cause death (from every state)"),
  fill = c("#eef2f7", stage_cols[["A"]], stage_cols[["B"]], stage_cols[["C"]], stage_cols[["D"]], "#5b5b5b", "#d9d9d9"),
  w = c(1.0, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 3.4))
fwd <- data.table(x = c(0.6, 2, 3.4, 4.8) + 0.5, xend = c(2, 3.4, 4.8, 6.2) - 0.5,
                  lab = c("incidence", sap_on("A to B"), sap_on("B to C"), paste0(sap_on("C to D"), "\nsurgery lowers")))
reg <- data.table(x = c(2, 3.4, 4.8, 6.2) - 0.1, xend = c(0.6, 2, 3.4, 4.8) + 0.1,
                  lab = c("remission", "regression", "regression", if (pdc_active) "regression" else "D to C fixed at 0"),
                  active = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, pdc_active))
death_from <- if (D_ONLY) "D" else STAGES
dth <- data.table(x = nodes[match(death_from, substr(lab, 1, 1)), x])
bus_y <- 0.2                                               # other-cause "bus" line
p_sch <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = nodes, aes(x, y, width = w, fill = fill), height = 0.5, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  geom_text(data = nodes, aes(x, y, label = lab), size = 3.1, lineheight = 0.9) +
  geom_segment(data = fwd, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = 1.07, yend = 1.07),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed"), linewidth = 0.5, colour = "grey25") +
  geom_text(data = fwd, aes(x = (x + xend) / 2, y = 1.5, label = lab), size = 2.6, lineheight = 0.9, colour = "grey25") +
  geom_curve(data = reg[active == TRUE], aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = 0.74, yend = 0.74), curvature = -0.35,
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.13, "cm"), type = "closed"), linewidth = 0.4, colour = "#6a51a3", linetype = "22") +
  geom_label(data = reg, aes(x = (x + xend) / 2, y = 0.5, label = lab), size = 2.4, label.size = 0, fill = "white",
             colour = ifelse(reg$active, "#6a51a3", "grey45")) +
  geom_segment(data = data.table(x = nodes$x[1:5] + 0.3), aes(x = x, xend = x, y = 0.75, yend = bus_y),
               linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60") +
  annotate("segment", x = nodes$x[1] + 0.3, xend = nodes$x[5] + 0.3, y = bus_y, yend = bus_y, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60") +
  annotate("segment", x = 3.4, xend = 3.4, y = bus_y, yend = 0.06, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60",
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm"), type = "closed"))
if (D_ONLY) {
  p_sch <- p_sch +
    annotate("segment", x = 6.7, xend = 7.1, y = 1.07, yend = 1.07, colour = "#b2182b", linewidth = 0.7,
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
    annotate("text", x = 6.9, y = 1.5, label = "RHD death: m_D\nsurgery lowers", size = 2.6, colour = "#b2182b", lineheight = 0.9)
} else {
  p_sch <- p_sch +
    geom_curve(data = dth, aes(x = x, xend = 7.6, y = 1.27, yend = 1.27), curvature = -0.25, colour = "#b2182b",
               linewidth = 0.5, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.13, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
    annotate("text", x = 6.9, y = 1.8, label = if (PROG) "stage mortality m_s" else "stage mortality m_s\nSAP lowers (legacy)",
             size = 2.6, colour = "#b2182b")
}
p_sch + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 8.2), ylim = c(-0.5, 1.9)) + theme_void()
```

The static diagram `docs/rhd_abcd_state_transition.png` is not reproduced here:
it predates the saved specification (it shows SAP acting on stage mortality and
other-cause death from stage A only). Figure M1 is drawn from the saved run's
specification instead.

Let $t$ index calendar years and let every quantity be an **age × sex matrix**
(single-year ages $0,\dots,100$ with an open terminal 100+ group; Female and
Male). The model tracks a susceptible **No-RHD** pool $W_t$, four living RHD
stocks $A_t, B_t, C_t, D_t$ and two absorbing outcomes, RHD death and
other-cause death.

**Population and background mortality.** Population $P_t$ is exogenous: the
WPP2024 estimates and medium-variant projection (`02`), by single age, sex and
year. Births enter age 0 with no RHD, and the No-RHD pool is $W_t = \max(P_t -
S_t, 0)$ with $S_t = A_t + B_t + C_t + D_t$, so it absorbs migration and
population-source differences. The disease engine's competing **other-cause
mortality** $\mu$ is **GBD all-cause minus RHD mortality**, year-specific
inside the calibration window and held at its `r BASE_YEAR` age–sex pattern in
the bridge and projection years, and identical for every state. WPP's own
mortality and fertility assumptions shape $P_t$ but are not inputs to the
disease engine.

**Incidence.** New RHD enters stage A. The engine's incidence probability is
per *susceptible* person: GBD incidence per total population, multiplied by the
Layer-2 band × sex correction $\alpha_{b(a),s}$ and divided by $(1 -$ GBD
prevalence$)$, applied **once** in `04b`. The projection uses the calibrated
`r BP$ir_anchor_year` pattern times the secular trend $\tau =$
`r fmt_f(bstate$meta$incidence_trend, 3)` per year:
$\iota_t = \iota_{`r BP$ir_anchor_year`}\,\tau^{\,t-`r BP$ir_anchor_year`}$.

## The annual cycle and competing risks

One shared engine (`R/abcd_engine.R`) runs every cycle in calibration (`04b`),
the bridge and the projection (`06`), in one order: **stocks entering year $t$
→ competing within-year flows → year-end stocks → ageing**. Within the year,
each state faces several annual event probabilities $p_1,\dots,p_k$; they
compete on the **hazard scale**:
$$
h_i = -\ln(1 - p_i), \qquad H = \sum_i h_i, \qquad
p^{\text{out}}_i = \big(1 - e^{-H}\big)\,\frac{h_i}{H}, \qquad
p^{\text{stay}} = e^{-H},
$$
so outflows plus the residual survival sum to one exactly and no clipping is
needed. The No-RHD pool faces {incidence, other-cause death}, giving
$N_t = W_t\,p^{\text{out}}_{W\to A}$. The year-end (pre-ageing) stocks are
$$
\begin{aligned}
A^{+}_t &= A_t\,p^{\text{stay}}_{A} + B_t\,p^{\text{out}}_{B\to A} + N_t \\
B^{+}_t &= B_t\,p^{\text{stay}}_{B} + A_t\,p^{\text{out}}_{A\to B} + C_t\,p^{\text{out}}_{C\to B} \\
C^{+}_t &= C_t\,p^{\text{stay}}_{C} + B_t\,p^{\text{out}}_{B\to C} + D_t\,p^{\text{out}}_{D\to C} \\
D^{+}_t &= D_t\,p^{\text{stay}}_{D} + C_t\,p^{\text{out}}_{C\to D},
\end{aligned}
$$
where stage A also loses $A_t\,p^{\text{out}}_{A\to\text{No RHD}}$ to remission.
Survivors then age one year, $A_{t+1} = \text{shift}(A^{+}_t)$, with the 100+
group accumulating. **Deaths and incident cases are within-year flows.** The
prevalence *observation* compared with GBD is `r prev_obs_label`
(`prev_obs = "`r PREV_OBS`"`), while dated scenario results below report the
end-of-year (pre-ageing) stock.

**Age structure of transitions.** The calibrated transitions apply at ages below
`r age_cut`. At ages ≥ `r age_cut` two calibrated multipliers scale the
progression hazards (A→B, B→C, C→D; ×`r fmt_f(BP$age_structure$adult_prog_mult, 3)`)
and the A→No-RHD remission hazard (×`r fmt_f(BP$age_structure$adult_remission_mult, 3)`),
$p^{\text{adult}} = 1 - (1 - p)^{\kappa}$. This is a parsimonious two-level age
pattern: within each level the transition is constant across age and sex, and
it does **not** imply age-specific stage-D mortality. The child evidence base
for regression and progression means the adult values are extrapolations that
the GBD age pattern, not cohort data, determines.

## Mortality structure

```{r methods-mortality, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (D_ONLY) {
  cat(sprintf(
"The saved run uses the **D-only** structure: RHD-attributable mortality in stages A,
B and C is **exactly zero** ($h = -\\ln(1-0) = 0$, so the hazard split assigns no RHD
deaths there), while competing other-cause mortality remains in every living state
and in the No-RHD pool. One stage-D mortality level $m_D$ is estimated (annual
probability **%s**, the same for all ages and both sexes), and the residual mortality
multiplier is **fixed at %s** (not estimated). Its prior centre (**%s**) is a
**provisional pooled proxy** — %s — not a validated annual transition and not a final
estimate; it is bounded to [%s, %s]. Age-stratified workbook values are not
implemented. The D-only structure is itself a modelling assumption requiring
clinical review.\n\n",
    fmt_pct(pdth[["D"]], 2), fmt_f(BP$residual_mortality_mult, 0), fmt_pct(SC$priors$mortality_centers[["D"]], 2),
    ptab[parameter == "log_mD", source], fmt_pct(SC$bounds$m_D[1], 0), fmt_pct(SC$bounds$m_D[2], 0)))
  cat("A labelled alternative, `all_stage`, gives every stage a severity-ordered RHD
mortality ($m_A \\le m_B < m_C < m_D$) with a bounded residual multiplier; it is not the
specification of the saved run, and no all-stage results are shown.\n\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf(
"The saved run uses the **all-stage** structure: severity-ordered stage mortality
$m_A \\le m_B < m_C < m_D$ (%s) with a bounded residual multiplier (%s, bounds %s). A
residual at its bound would be a validation failure.\n\n",
    paste(sprintf("%s = %s", STAGES, fmt_pct(pdth[STAGES], 3)), collapse = ", "),
    fmt_f(BP$residual_mortality_mult, 3), paste(SC$bounds$residual_mult, collapse = "–")))
}
```

Stage shares — including the stage-D share — are **not free parameters**: they
emerge from the calibrated incidence, transitions and mortality. The recorded
D share (`rhd_d_fraction` = `r fmt_pct(BP$rhd_d_fraction, 2)`) is the model's
D share entering `r cal_y1`, a derived quantity.

## Intervention mechanism, adherence and surgery

Only the **care cascade (and, where specified, adherence) differs between the
arms**; surgery coverage and incidence inputs are identical. Effective treatment
coverage is $c^{tx}_t = \min(c^{scr}_t, c^{dx}_t, c^{trt}_t)$, where $c^{scr}_t$ is
screening *reach*, $c^{dx}_t$ diagnosis coverage and $c^{trt}_t$ SAP coverage of all
prevalent RHD. The minimum is a **simplifying programme-reach (cumulative-coverage)
ceiling**: it is retained because it reproduces the reference care embedded in the
calibration, and it is **not** a mechanistic screening-only route to diagnosis or
treatment, nor a measured care cascade. The effective protection is
$c_t = c^{tx}_t \times a_t$ with $a_t$ the adherence modifier of that arm.

```{r methods-sap, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (PROG) {
  cat(sprintf(
"With the **progression** mechanism, SAP multiplies the hazard of each supported
progression pathway $i\\to j \\in \\{A\\to B, B\\to C, C\\to D\\}$:
$$
h_{ij}(c_t) = h_{ij}(0)\\,\\big[1 - c_t\\,(1 - \\mathrm{HR}_{ij})\\big],
\\qquad p_{ij}(c_t) = 1 - \\big(1 - p_{ij}(0)\\big)^{\\,1 - c_t(1-\\mathrm{HR}_{ij})}.
$$
This is a **population-average hazard approximation**, not an exact individual-level
mixture of protected and unprotected annual risks. There is **no direct SAP mortality
multiplier** in this mode (`eff_cf` = 1 throughout); fewer people reach stage D, and
the mortality effect emerges through the stage trajectories. The saved hazard ratios
are A→B **%s**, B→C **%s** and C→D **%s**. The A→B and B→C values convert GOAL-trial
arm risks (children with latent RHD, 24-month follow-up, as curated in the
collaborators' workbook) to hazard ratios under a **provisional** mapping of GOAL
categories to WHF stages A and B; the trial is not in the project bibliography. The
C→D value is an **assumption** carried from Coates et al. (2021), who applied an
acute-rheumatic-fever recurrence risk ratio to progression to heart failure; it is not
pathway-specific trial evidence. At target protection (%s) the three hazards fall by
%s, %s and %s; in the reference arm (%s) by %s, %s and %s. The legacy direct-mortality
mechanism (a %s cut in every stage's RHD death probability) is an explicit comparator
only and is not used here.\n\n",
    fmt_f(hr_vec[["A_to_B"]], 3), fmt_f(hr_vec[["B_to_C"]], 3), fmt_f(hr_vec[["C_to_D"]], 3),
    fmt_pct(c_tgt, 1),
    fmt_pct(c_tgt * (1 - hr_vec[["A_to_B"]]), 1), fmt_pct(c_tgt * (1 - hr_vec[["B_to_C"]]), 1), fmt_pct(c_tgt * (1 - hr_vec[["C_to_D"]]), 1),
    fmt_pct(c_ref0, 2),
    fmt_pct(c_ref0 * (1 - hr_vec[["A_to_B"]]), 2), fmt_pct(c_ref0 * (1 - hr_vec[["B_to_C"]]), 2), fmt_pct(c_ref0 * (1 - hr_vec[["C_to_D"]]), 2),
    fmt_pct(eff$sap_rrr_rhd_death, 0)))
} else {
  cat(sprintf(
"With the legacy **direct-mortality** mechanism, every stage's RHD death probability is
multiplied by $1 - \\rho\\,c_t$ with $\\rho$ = %s. This is a provisional comparator.\n\n",
    fmt_pct(eff$sap_rrr_rhd_death, 0)))
}
```

**No direct effect on incidence.** SAP does not change the incidence hazard
($\text{eff\_ir} = 1$). Incident-case *counts* can still differ between arms,
because the susceptible pool $W_t = P_t - S_t$ differs when the RHD stock
differs; prevalence and stage composition can also change. Their direction in
the saved run is derived in the [results](#results).

**Reference care is applied once.** Calibrated transitions and mortality are
**untreated natural-history** parameters: `04b` runs the engine with the
reference arm's effective treatment (`r fmt_pct(rc$treatment_effective, 2)`),
adherence (`r fmt_f(rc$adherence, 2)`) and surgery coverage
(`r fmt_pct(rc$surgery, 1)`) applied inside the objective, and `06` applies the
same reference care to the reference arm (checked above), so care is never
counted twice or renormalised.

**Surgery** is a **service**, not a state. A fraction $f_C$ of stage C and $f_D$
of stage D requires surgery each year, and coverage $c^{surg}$ is delivered; the
population-average reach $r_C = f_C\,c^{surg}$, $r_D = f_D\,c^{surg}$ scales
$p_{CD}$ by $(1 - \rho^{surg}_{CD}\,r_C)$ (before the SAP hazard multiplier) and
$m_D$ by $(1 - \rho^{surg}_{Dd}\,r_D)$. Surgical volumes are traced on
start-of-year stocks for costing and never removed from a stock; there is no
post-operative state.

## Programme volumes: screening encounters and SAP {#programme-volumes}

```{r methods-volumes, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
sched_terms <- paste(sprintf("\\tfrac{%g}{%d}\\,P_{%d\\text{–}%d,t}", sched$n_screens, sched$window_years,
                             sched$age_lo, sched$age_hi), collapse = " + ")
cat(sprintf(
"**Screening encounters.** Screening is scheduled by age. Each inclusive window
$[a_g^{lo}, a_g^{hi}]$ with $n_g$ screens over its $W_g = a_g^{hi} - a_g^{lo} + 1$ years
contributes $n_g/W_g$ expected encounters per person-year at every age inside it: %s.
Ages outside %s contribute none. For arm $s$ and year $t$, with screening reach
$c^{scr}_{s,t}$ and population $P$ (both sexes, from WPP),
$$
N^{screen}_{s,t} = c^{scr}_{s,t}\\Big[%s\\Big],\\qquad
C^{screen}_{s,t} = u_{screen}\\,N^{screen}_{s,t}.
$$
`06` computes this at single-year age × sex resolution and sums it; `08` multiplies by
the unit cost only, so the multipliers are applied exactly once. Both arms use the same
schedule with their own reach trajectory. These are **expected annual volumes** of a
programme spread evenly across each window (possibly fractional): they are not unique
people ever screened, and no individual screening history or screening date is
modelled.\n\n",
  paste(sprintf("ages %d–%d (inclusive, %d years): %g screen%s → %s per person-year", sched$age_lo, sched$age_hi,
                sched$window_years, sched$n_screens, ifelse(sched$n_screens == 1, "", "s"), fmt_f(sched$annual_multiplier, 4)),
        collapse = "; "),
  paste(sprintf("%d–%d", sched$age_lo, sched$age_hi), collapse = " and "), sched_terms))
cat(
"**Evidence and status.** The WHO 2024 guideline on the prevention and diagnosis of
rheumatic fever and RHD supports population echocardiographic screening at ages 5–19
in populations with moderate or high RHD prevalence (summary of recommendations,
<https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK609692/>; not in the project bibliography). The
adult window and both screening frequencies are **scenario assumptions**, not
WHO-prescribed schedules.\n\n")
cat(
"**SAP volume.** SAP person-years are the start-of-year living prevalent RHD stock
(every stage, every age) times SAP coverage:
$$
N^{SAP}_{s,t} = S^{start}_{s,t}\\;c^{tx}_{s,t},\\qquad C^{SAP}_{s,t} = u_{SAP}\\,N^{SAP}_{s,t},
$$
where $c^{tx}$ is the share of **all** prevalent RHD receiving SAP — not a share of the
population, of the people screened that year, or a conditional cascade probability. SAP
therefore continues in years without screening and after people age out of the
screening windows, and clinical diagnosis outside screening is **subsumed** in this
provisional coverage (no separate clinical-diagnosis pathway is modelled). The encounter
multipliers never cap or scale SAP coverage, treatment volumes or health effects:
changing the screening frequency alone changes encounter volumes and screening cost
only.\n\n")
cat(
"**Four distinct quantities.** (1) *Annual screening encounters* $N^{screen}$ — a volume,
costed; (2) *programme reach* $c^{scr}$ — a share of scheduled encounters delivered, which
also caps $c^{tx}$ through the reach ceiling above; (3) *prevalent RHD on SAP* $N^{SAP}$ —
delivered person-years, costed; (4) *effective protection* $c_t = c^{tx}_t a_t$ — the
quantity that changes progression hazards. The adherence modifier $a_t$ attenuates
protection once; it does not reduce the delivered SAP volume or its cost.\n\n")
cat(
"**Limitations of prevalence × coverage.** The SAP volume does not represent
guideline-specific eligibility (for example by WHF stage and age), prophylaxis
duration, initiation and discontinuation, or retention states; these are not modelled
in this revision.\n\n")
```

## Initialisation

```{r methods-init, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
bc <- as.data.table(SC$burnin_check)
br <- as.data.table(SC$bridge_reconciliation)
bridge_years <- if (!is.null(br) && nrow(br)) sort(unique(br[!grepl("seed", measure), year])) else integer(0)
seed_row <- if (!is.null(br) && nrow(br)) br[grepl("seed", measure)] else NULL
cat(sprintf(
"**Equilibrium initialisation (calibration).** Each candidate parameter set is projected
from a **zero start** through a **%d-cycle burn-in** under first-window-year (%d)
population, incidence, background mortality and reference care, giving the
transition-implied stage equilibrium entering %d. Convergence is checked against a
**%d-cycle burn-in**: the largest relative difference in a stage total is %s
(burn-in converged: **%s**), and the penalised objective with the doubled burn-in is
%s versus %s at the optimum.\n\n",
  as.integer(SC$priors$burn_years), cal_y0, cal_y0, 2L * as.integer(SC$priors$burn_years),
  fmt_e(max(bc$rel_diff_2x)), SC$statuses$burn_in_converged,
  fmt_f(OC$L_with_2x_burnin, 4), fmt_f(OC$L_min, 4)))
cat(sprintf(
"**Evolved historical state.** From that equilibrium the engine runs forward through the
calibration window %d–%d with year-specific GBD background mortality and WPP
population, so the %d state reflects the calibrated dynamics rather than an
equilibrium.\n\n", cal_y0, cal_y1, cal_y1))
if (!is.null(BP$initial_state)) {
  cat(sprintf(
"**Analysis-start seed.** The calibrated end-of-%d state is projected forward through
the bridge years %s under reference care (method recorded as: *%s*). The result is the
stock entering %d: **%s** people living with RHD, %s in stages A/B/C/D. It is **not**
reset to a fixed clinical stage split and is **not** forced to equal GBD prevalence%s.\n\n",
    cal_y1, if (length(bridge_years)) paste0(min(bridge_years), "–", max(bridge_years)) else "(none)",
    BP$initial_state$method, base_year, fmt_n(seed_tot), paste(fmt_pct(seed_share, 1), collapse = " / "),
    if (!is.null(seed_row) && nrow(seed_row) && is.finite(seed_row$ratio_model_over_rate_x_wpp))
      sprintf(" (it is %s of a GBD-%d-rate × WPP-%d-population stock)",
              paste0(fmt_f(seed_row$ratio_model_over_rate_x_wpp, 2), "×"), BASE_YEAR, base_year) else ""))
} else {
  cat("**Analysis-start seed.** No 04b analysis-start state was saved; the seed source recorded by 05 is:",
      bstate$meta$seed_source, "\n\n")
}
```

## Calibration {#calibration}

Calibration has **two layers**. Both target **GBD RHD-specific** epidemiology;
GBD all-cause deaths are used for validation only.

**Layer 1 — aggregate proxy (`04`).** Despite the script name, Layer 1 is not a
random search. For each sex it fits a prior-anchored **well–sick–dead** proxy
without remission, with hazard-based competing risks, one incidence correction
$\alpha_g$ and one aggregate RHD-mortality correction $\beta_g$ per broad age
band $g$ (`r paste(calibb$meta$bands, collapse = ", ")`), against GBD published
**Number** targets for RHD incidence, prevalence and deaths, `r cal_y0`–`r cal_y1`:
$$
L_1=\sum_{X\in\{I,P,D\}} w_X\,\frac{\sum_j \omega_j\big[\ln(X^{\text{mod}}_j+\varepsilon)-\ln(X^{\text{GBD}}_j+\varepsilon)\big]^2}{\sum_j\omega_j}
+\lambda\sum_g\Big[\tfrac{(\ln\alpha_g)^2}{\sigma_\alpha^2}+\tfrac{(\ln\beta_g)^2}{\sigma_\beta^2}\Big]
+\lambda_{s}\sum_g\big[(\Delta^2\ln\alpha_g)^2+(\Delta^2\ln\beta_g)^2\big].
$$
Saved settings: weights $w_I, w_P, w_D$ =
`r paste(L1$optimizer_diagnostics$weights, collapse = ", ")`; inverse-variance
weights $\omega_j$ from GBD uncertainty intervals
**`r if (isTRUE(L1$optimizer_diagnostics$used_iv_weights)) "used" else "not used"`**;
$\sigma_\alpha$ = `r L1$optimizer_diagnostics$priors[["sigma_alpha"]]`,
$\sigma_\beta$ = `r L1$optimizer_diagnostics$priors[["sigma_beta"]]`,
$\lambda$ = `r L1$optimizer_diagnostics$priors[["lambda_prior"]]`,
$\lambda_s$ = `r L1$optimizer_diagnostics$priors[["lambda_smooth"]]`; bounded
`r L1$optimizer_diagnostics$optimizer` L-BFGS-B with
`r L1$optimizer_diagnostics$n_starts` random starts plus the all-ones baseline,
sequenced mortality → incidence → joint. Its recorded role is
*`r gsub("_", " ", L1$role)`*: Layer-1 $\alpha$ are **starting values** for
Layer 2, and its $\beta$ / case fatality are diagnostics only.

**Layer 2 — joint structural fit on the production engine (`04b`).** Layer 2
runs the actual A/B/C/D engine inside the objective and **jointly** estimates
the incidence corrections $\alpha_{b,s}$ (`r length(BP$incidence_alpha$alpha)`
band × sex values), the transitions, the stage-D mortality level and the two
adult hazard multipliers, with reference care applied in the engine. The loss
is
$$
\begin{aligned}
L_2 ={}& w_P\,\bar\ell_P + w_D\,\bar\ell_D + w_I\,\bar\ell_I + w_S\,\bar\ell_S
 + \lambda_m \frac{(\ln m_D - \ln m^0_D)^2}{\sigma_m^2}\\
&+ \lambda_s\Big[\sum_k \frac{(\operatorname{logit} p_k - \operatorname{logit} p^0_k)^2}{\sigma_p^2}
 + \sum_{b,s}\frac{(\ln\alpha_{b,s})^2}{\sigma_\alpha^2} + R_{\text{age}}\Big]
 + \lambda_{\Delta}\sum_s\sum_b\big(\Delta^2\ln\alpha_{b,s}\big)^2,\\
\bar\ell_X ={}& \frac{\sum_{j\in\mathcal M_X} \omega_j\,\big[\ln(X^{\text{mod}}_j+\varepsilon)-\ln(X^{\text{tgt}}_j+\varepsilon)\big]^2}{\sum_{j\in\mathcal M_X}\omega_j},
\end{aligned}
$$
where $\mathcal M_X$ is the set of unmasked age-group × sex × year cells of
measure $X$ (both sexes pooled), $\bar\ell_S$ is the error on usable
stage-prevalence targets (zero when none are used) and $R_{\text{age}}$ the
prior on the log adult multipliers.

```{r tbl-l2-settings, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
wv <- OC$weights
l2set <- data.table(
  Setting = c("Weights w_P / w_D / w_I / w_S", "Prevalence : death weight ratio (total data weight)",
              "Mortality prior weight λ_m; structural prior weight λ_s",
              "σ_m (log m_D); σ_p (logit transitions); σ_α (log α)", "Smoothness weight λ_Δ on α",
              "Inverse-variance weights (Layer 2)", "Calibration window (projected)", "Scored years (weight > 0)",
              "Held-out years (projected, weight 0; validation)", "Death-target age floor", "Masking (as recorded)",
              "Target basis", "Prevalence observation", "Optimiser starts",
              "Prior / data term ratio at optimum", "Near-optimal band (δ)", "Prior σ on adult multipliers"),
  Value = c(paste(fmt_f(wv[c("W_PREV", "W_DEATH", "W_INC", "W_STAGE")], 2), collapse = " / "),
            sprintf("%s : 1 (%s)", fmt_f(OC$prev_death_ratio, 2), fmt_f(OC$data_weight_total, 2)),
            sprintf("%s; %s", fmt_f(OC$lambda_prior_mortality, 2), fmt_f(OC$lambda_prior_structural, 2)),
            sprintf("%s; %s; %s", SC$priors$sigma_mort, SC$priors$sigma_trans, SC$priors$sigma_alpha),
            fmt_f(SC$priors$lambda_smooth_alpha, 2),
            if (isTRUE(OC$iv_weights$used)) sprintf("used (normalised, capped at %s)", OC$iv_weights$cap) else "not used",
            sprintf("%d–%d", cal_y0, cal_y1), sprintf("%d–%d", match_from, cal_y1),
            if (match_from > cal_y0) sprintf("%d–%d", cal_y0, match_from - 1L) else "none",
            if (death_floor > 0) sprintf("death cells with ages below %d excluded from the loss", death_floor) else "none (all ages scored)",
            OC$masking, gbd_basis_label, prev_obs_label,
            sprintf("prior centre, Layer-1 α, prevalence-first and %d random", as.integer(OC$n_starts)),
            fmt_f(OC$prior_over_data_ratio, 3), "not recorded in the saved bundle", "not recorded in the saved bundle"))
kable(l2set, caption = "Table 2. Layer-2 objective settings, read from the saved calibration bundle",
      align = c("l", "l")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE, font_size = 12) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

In the saved run the prevalence : death weight ratio is
**`r fmt_f(OC$prev_death_ratio, 1)` : 1** with total data weight
**`r fmt_f(OC$data_weight_total, 1)`**, and the direct incidence weight is
**`r fmt_f(w_struct[["W_INC"]], 2)`**: incidence is still estimated (through
$\alpha$, under a weak prior centred on the GBD pattern) and is **reported as a
validation output**`r if (w_struct[["W_INC"]] > 0) ", and it also enters the loss" else ", not fitted directly"`.
The mortality prior keeps weight `r fmt_f(OC$lambda_prior_mortality, 2)` while
structural priors carry `r fmt_f(OC$lambda_prior_structural, 2)`, because the
data terms are means over many cells and the priors are sums over parameters.

**Inverse-variance weighting is a separate setting in each layer.** Layer 1
`r if (isTRUE(L1$optimizer_diagnostics$used_iv_weights)) "uses" else "does not use"`
weights from GBD uncertainty intervals and Layer 2
`r if (isTRUE(OC$iv_weights$used)) "uses" else "does not use"` them. GBD
uncertainty intervals are not independent measurement errors across age groups
and years, so such weights are a heuristic, not a likelihood.

**Targets.** Layer-2 targets are built on the **`r gbd_basis_label`** basis
(`target_basis = "`r gbd_basis`"`): `r if (identical(gbd_basis, "rate_x_pop")) "GBD rates multiplied by the WPP population of the same age-sex-year cell, which is the model's own denominator, rather than published GBD counts with WPP denominators" else "published GBD counts"`.
Missing target cells and counts below the stored threshold are **masked** (not
treated as observed zeros). Years `r cal_y0`–`r match_from - 1L` are projected
from the burn-in but carry zero weight, so they act as **held-out** years.
`r if (death_floor > 0) sprintf("**Death-target cells below age %d are excluded from the loss** (they are retained as validation, and scored adult deaths are distinguished from all-age totals below). Under a natural history entered through stage A with deaths only from stage D, the model cannot generate GBD's childhood RHD deaths without an acute or rapidly fatal childhood pathway that is not modelled; including them would force faster progression at all ages. This is an unresolved **structural limitation**, and the exclusion is an observation-definition choice flagged for clinical review, not a clinically validated decision.", death_floor) else "All death-target ages are scored."`

**Incidence transfer.** The final Layer-2 $\alpha$ are applied once, inside the
per-susceptible incidence probability saved for `r BP$ir_anchor_year`
(`best_parameters$ir_calibrated`). `05` reads that array
(incidence source: *`r bstate$meta$incidence_source`*) and multiplies it only by
the secular trend, so no correction factor is applied twice; the Layer-1
$\alpha$ survive only as the `alpha_layer1_start` column.

## Scenarios

```{r tbl-scenarios, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
scn_tbl <- data.table(
  Scenario = scenario_labels[scenario_levels],
  `Care cascade (screening reach / diagnosis / SAP coverage)` = c(
    sprintf("held at baseline (%s / %s / %s)", fmt_pct(cov$ref$screen[1], 1), fmt_pct(cov$ref$diagnosis[1], 1),
            fmt_pct(cov$ref$treatment[1], 2)),
    sprintf("%s / %s / %s → %s / %s / %s (by %d)", fmt_pct(cov$sap$screen[1], 1), fmt_pct(cov$sap$diagnosis[1], 1),
            fmt_pct(cov$sap$treatment[1], 2), fmt_pct(max(cov$sap$screen), 0), fmt_pct(max(cov$sap$diagnosis), 0),
            fmt_pct(max(cov$sap$treatment), 0), ramp_end)),
  `Adherence modifier (first → last year)` = vapply(scenario_levels, function(s)
    sprintf("%s → %s", fmt_f(cov[[s]]$adherence[1], 2), fmt_f(cov[[s]]$adherence[length(cov_years)], 2)), ""),
  `Surgery coverage` = vapply(scenario_levels, function(s) fmt_pct(cov[[s]]$surgery[1], 1), ""),
  `In outputs` = fifelse(scenario_levels %in% scenarios_present, "yes", "no"))
kable(scn_tbl, caption = "Table 3. The two modelled arms, as saved in baseline_state.rds.",
      align = c("l", "l", "c", "c", "c")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE, font_size = 13) |>

# Calibration diagnostics {#calibration-diagnostics}

These diagnostics are read from `calibrated_rhd_parameters.rds`
(`$stage_calibration`, `$layer1`, `$layer2_targets`). The CSV files
`calibration_structural_*.csv` and `calibration_layer2_*.csv` mirror the same
objects and are not re-read.

## Calibration status

```{r calib-status, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
st_tab <- data.table(
  Field = c("Overall status", "Structural validation", "Numerical (optimiser)", "Epidemiological fit (last calibration year)",
            "Burn-in converged (2× check)", "Excess-death attribution", "Parameters at a bound",
            "Stage targets detected / usable / used"),
  Value = c(SC$status, SC$statuses$structural, SC$statuses$numerical, SC$statuses$epidemiological_fit,
            as.character(SC$statuses$burn_in_converged), EDA$classification,
            if (length(SC$bounds$boundary_hits)) paste(SC$bounds$boundary_hits, collapse = ", ") else "none",
            sprintf("%d / %d / %d", as.integer(SC$stage_targets_n_detected), as.integer(SC$stage_targets_n_usable),
                    as.integer(SC$stage_targets_n_used))))
kable(st_tab, caption = "Table C1. Separate structural, numerical and epidemiological-fit statuses (as saved)",
      align = c("l", "l")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE, font_size = 12) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |> column_spec(1, width = "6cm")
```

A status beginning with `calibrated` means the structural checks passed and the
parameters were written; **it does not by itself certify a satisfactory
epidemiological fit**. The fit status compares the last-year totals with the
recorded tolerances, which are labels, not acceptance tests.

## Target basis reconciliation

```{r calib-recon, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
rec <- as.data.table(calibb$layer2_target_reconciliation)
if (is.null(rec) || !nrow(rec)) {
  not_saved("The Layer-2 target reconciliation")
} else {
  rec_s <- rec[, .(`Number (sum)` = sum(number), `Rate × WPP pop (sum)` = sum(rate_x_pop),
                   `Min ratio` = min(ratio_number_over_rate_x_pop), `Max ratio` = max(ratio_number_over_rate_x_pop)),
               by = .(Measure = measure)]
  rec_s[, `Ratio, window total` := `Number (sum)` / `Rate × WPP pop (sum)`]
  rec_d <- copy(rec_s)
  rec_d[, `:=`(`Number (sum)` = fmt_n(`Number (sum)`), `Rate × WPP pop (sum)` = fmt_n(`Rate × WPP pop (sum)`),
               `Min ratio` = fmt_f(`Min ratio`, 3), `Max ratio` = fmt_f(`Max ratio`, 3),
               `Ratio, window total` = fmt_f(`Ratio, window total`, 3))]
  kable(rec_d, caption = paste0("Table C2. GBD published Number vs GBD Rate × WPP population, ", cal_y0, "–", cal_y1,
                                 " (ratios by sex × year). Selected basis: ", gbd_basis_label, "."),
        align = c("l", rep("r", 5))) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) |>
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
}
```

The ratio isolates differences between the GBD and WPP population sources from
model residuals. Model/target ratios elsewhere in this report use the selected
basis, so model counts (WPP denominators) are compared with targets on the same
denominators.

## Scored and excluded observations

```{r calib-scored, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
fl <- as.data.table(SC$fit_by_group_year)
fl[, glo := grp_lo[age_group]]
min_count <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub(".*counts < ([0-9.eE+-]+) masked.*", "\\1", OC$masking)))
fl[, status := fcase(held_out, "held-out year (weight 0; validation)",
                     in_loss, "scored in the loss",
                     is.na(target_used), "masked: missing target",
                     measure == "Incidence" & w_struct[["W_INC"]] == 0, "validation only (incidence weight 0)",
                     measure == "Deaths" & death_floor > 0 & glo < death_floor, sprintf("masked: below death-target age floor (%d)", death_floor),
                     default = "masked: below count threshold")]
sc_tab <- dcast(fl[, .N, by = .(measure, status)], status ~ measure, value.var = "N", fill = 0)
setnames(sc_tab, "status", "Cell status (age group × sex × year)")
kable(sc_tab, caption = paste0("Table C3. Target cells by status, ", cal_y0, "–", cal_y1,
                               if (is.finite(min_count)) sprintf(" (count threshold %g)", min_count) else ""),
      align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(sc_tab) - 1))) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

## Fit by year: prevalence, deaths and incidence

```{r calib-fit-year, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=6.5}
fy <- rbindlist(list(
  fl[measure == "Prevalence", .(panel = "Prevalence (scored)", model = sum(model), target = sum(target_used, na.rm = TRUE)), by = year],
  if (death_floor > 0)
    fl[measure == "Deaths" & glo >= death_floor, .(panel = sprintf("RHD deaths, ages %d+ (scored)", death_floor),
                                                   model = sum(model), target = sum(target_used, na.rm = TRUE)), by = year],
  fl[measure == "Deaths", .(panel = if (death_floor > 0) "RHD deaths, all ages (validation)" else "RHD deaths, all ages (scored)",
                            model = sum(model), target = sum(target_used, na.rm = TRUE)), by = year],
  fl[measure == "Incidence", .(panel = if (w_struct[["W_INC"]] > 0) "Incidence (scored)" else "Incidence (validation only)",
                               model = sum(model), target = sum(target_used, na.rm = TRUE)), by = year]))
fy[, panel := factor(panel, levels = unique(panel))]
fy_l <- melt(fy, id.vars = c("panel", "year"), variable.name = "src", value.name = "v")
fy_l[, src := factor(fifelse(src == "model", "Model", "GBD target"), levels = names(src_cols))]
ggplot(fy_l, aes(year, v, colour = src)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = cal_y0 - 0.5, xmax = match_from - 0.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.10, fill = "grey40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = src_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(title = "Layer-2 fit by year (both sexes; summed over age groups)",
       subtitle = paste0("Grey band = held-out years (projected, weight 0). Prevalence observation: ", PREV_OBS,
                         "; targets on the ", gbd_basis_label, " basis"),
       x = "Year", y = "Count") +
  base_theme(12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r calib-fit-text, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

fy_last[, ratio := fifelse(target > 0, model / target, NA_real_)]

            paste(sprintf("%s: **%s** GBD", as.character(fy_last$panel), vapply(fy_last$ratio, rel_phrase, "")),

## Fit by age in the last calibration year

```{r calib-fit-age, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.6}
fa <- fl[year == cal_y1 & measure %in% c("Prevalence", "Deaths"),

%s GBD. The childhood gap is the structural limitation described above, not a fitted

    fmt_n(cm$model), if (cm$target > 0) fmt_pct(cm$model / cm$target, 0) else "n/a", death_floor,
    if (am$target > 0) rel_phrase(am$model / am$target) else "not comparable with"))
}
