## Fitted parameters, priors and bounds

```{r calib-params, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
pt <- copy(ptab)
pt[, `:=`(lo = mapply(par_scale, parameter, lower), hi = mapply(par_scale, parameter, upper))]
pt[, kind := fcase(grepl("^p_", parameter), "transition (annual probability)",
                   parameter == "log_mD", "stage-D mortality (annual probability)",
                   grepl("^log_adult", parameter), "adult hazard multiplier",
                   grepl("^alpha", parameter), "incidence multiplier α (band | sex)",
                   default = "other")]
pt[, Parameter := fcase(parameter == "log_mD", "m_D",
                        parameter == "log_adult_prog_mult", "adult progression multiplier",
                        parameter == "log_adult_remission_mult", "adult remission multiplier",
                        default = parameter)]
pt[, `At bound` := fifelse(at_lower, "lower", fifelse(at_upper, "upper", ""))]
pt_d <- pt[, .(Type = kind, Parameter, Fitted = fmt_sig(value, 4), `Prior centre` = fmt_sig(prior_center, 4),
               Bounds = paste0(fmt_sig(lo, 3), " – ", fmt_sig(hi, 3)), `At bound`, Source = source)]
if (D_ONLY)
  pt_d <- rbind(pt_d, data.table(Type = "stage A/B/C mortality", Parameter = "m_A, m_B, m_C", Fitted = "0",
                                 `Prior centre` = "—", Bounds = "fixed", `At bound` = "",
                                 Source = "D-only structure: exact structural zeros (no prior, no log(0))"))
datatable(pt_d, rownames = FALSE, caption = "Table C5. Layer-2 parameters: fitted value, prior centre, bounds and provenance (as saved).",
          options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "tip"))
```

`r if (length(SC$bounds$boundary_hits)) paste0("**Parameters at a bound:** ", paste(SC$bounds$boundary_hits, collapse = ", "), ". A bound hit means the data (or the other parameters) push the value to the edge of the widened literature range; the fitted value there is not an interior estimate.") else "No Layer-2 parameter sits at a bound."`

```{r calib-stage-text, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
"Entering %d the modelled stage shares are A %s, B %s, C %s and D %s. %s The realised
stage-D death risk in %d (deaths from D divided by the start-of-year D stock) is %s per
year, against the fitted untreated m_D of %s; the difference reflects reference-arm
surgery and competing other-cause death.\n\n",
  cal_y1, fmt_pct(sh_last[["A"]], 1), fmt_pct(sh_last[["B"]], 1), fmt_pct(sh_last[["C"]], 1), fmt_pct(sh_last[["D"]], 2),
  if (is.finite(EDA$d_share_proxy_gbd_hf))
    sprintf("For orientation only, the provisional GBD heart-failure-due-to-RHD proxy share used to define the stage-D mortality prior is %s; it is not a calibration target.",
            fmt_pct(EDA$d_share_proxy_gbd_hf, 2)) else "",
  cal_y1, fmt_pct(dfat[year == cal_y1, realized_D_death_risk], 2), fmt_pct(pdth[["D"]], 2)))
```

## Partial identification

```{r calib-ident, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
idt <- as.data.table(SC$identifiability)
if (is.null(idt) || !nrow(idt)) {
  not_saved("The identifiability sweep")
} else {
  idisp <- idt[, .(Parameter = parameter, `Flatness (share of range near-optimal)` = fmt_f(flatness, 2), `Label` = status)]
  kable(idisp, caption = "Table C8. One-at-a-time flatness of the penalised objective (other parameters at the optimum)",
        align = c("l", "r", "l")) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) |>
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
}
```

```{r calib-nearopt, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
nse <- as.data.table(SC$accepted_parameter_sets)
n_flat <- if (!is.null(idt) && nrow(idt)) idt[status != "data-identified", .N] else NA_integer_
cat(sprintf(
"The sweep labels **%s** parameter(s) as flat (%s). This is a one-at-a-time profile of
the *penalised* objective: low flatness shows that the objective rises when one
parameter moves alone, not that the data identify it jointly — correlated parameters
can trade off, and the priors contribute to the curvature.\n\n",
  if (is.na(n_flat)) "an unknown number of" else n_flat,
  if (!is.na(n_flat) && n_flat > 0) paste(idt[status != "data-identified", parameter], collapse = ", ") else "none"))
if (!is.null(nse) && nrow(nse))
  cat(sprintf(
"**%d** optimiser solution(s) lie inside the near-optimal band (objective %s–%s), from %d
starts in total (prior centre, Layer-1 α, prevalence-first and %d random). These are
alternative optima from a handful of starts, not draws from a posterior and not
uncertainty intervals.\n\n",
    nrow(nse), fmt_f(min(nse$L), 4), fmt_f(max(nse$L), 4), nrow(as.data.table(SC$convergence)), as.integer(OC$n_starts)))
if (as.integer(SC$stage_targets_n_used) == 0L)
  cat("No usable local echocardiographic stage-prevalence targets were used, so the A/B/C/D split is
**partially identified**: GBD supplies only total prevalence and deaths, and the stage split is
determined by the model structure, priors and bounds as much as by data.\n")
```

# Baseline (reference-arm) trend and validation

The panels below show the **reference arm** over the analysis horizon
(**`r sim_horizon`**) next to the GBD historical series
(`r if (have_gbd) paste0("2000–", gbd_last) else "unavailable"`). Solid lines are
GBD; dashed lines are the model. GBD counts are on the calibration target basis
(**`r gbd_basis_label`**), and model prevalence uses the same observation
convention as the calibration (`r PREV_OBS`), so the two are comparable at the
join; model rates are counts divided by WPP population. Each rate is also shown
**age-standardised** to the fixed `r BASE_YEAR` age × sex structure (the GBD rate
reference year, not the model's first analysis year).

```{r baseline-aggregates, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
ref <- wsd[scenario == "ref"]
mod_pop <- ref[, .(pop = sum(pop)), by = year]
mod_yr  <- ref[, .(inc = sum(newcases), prev = sum(prev_obs), rhd_deaths = sum(dead),
                   all_deaths = sum(all.mx)), by = year]
mod_yr  <- merge(mod_yr, mod_pop, by = "year")
mod_yr[, `:=`(inc_rate  = inc / pop * 1000,
              prev_rate = prev / pop * 1000,
              rhd_mort  = rhd_deaths / pop * 1e5,
              all_mort  = all_deaths / pop * 1e5)]

build_hist <- function(cause, measure, per = 1000) {
  cnt <- gbd_count_yr(cause, measure)
  if (is.null(cnt) || is.null(gbd_pop_yr)) return(NULL)
  h <- merge(cnt, gbd_pop_yr, by = "year")
  h[, rate := count / pop * per]
  h[year >= 2000][order(year)]
}
h_inc   <- build_hist(CAUSE, "Incidence", 1000)
h_prev  <- build_hist(CAUSE, "Prevalence", 1000)
h_rhdmx <- build_hist(CAUSE, "Deaths", 1e5)
h_allmx <- build_hist("All causes", "Deaths", 1e5)

# ---- Age-standardised rates (direct standardisation to BASE_YEAR, age group x sex)
have_asr <- have_pop && BASE_YEAR %in% pop_obs$year
if (have_asr) {
  std_gs    <- pop_obs[year == BASE_YEAR, .(std = sum(Nx)), by = .(grp = age_to_grp(age), sex)]
  std_total <- sum(std_gs$std)
  refg_asr <- copy(ref)
  refg_asr[, grp := age_to_grp(age)]
  mga <- refg_asr[, .(inc = sum(newcases), prev = sum(prev_obs), rhd = sum(dead),
                      allmx = sum(all.mx), pop = sum(pop)), by = .(year, sex, grp)]
  mga <- merge(mga, std_gs, by = c("grp", "sex"))
  mod_asr_yr <- mga[, .(
      inc_rate  = sum(inc   / pop * std) / std_total * 1000,
      prev_rate = sum(prev  / pop * std) / std_total * 1000,
      rhd_mort  = sum(rhd   / pop * std) / std_total * 1e5,
      all_mort  = sum(allmx / pop * std) / std_total * 1e5),
      by = year][order(year)]
} else {
  std_gs <- NULL; std_total <- NA_real_; mod_asr_yr <- NULL
}
gbd_asr_yr <- function(cause, measure, per = 1000) {
  if (!have_gbd || !have_asr) return(NULL)
  r <- gbd[cause_name == cause & measure_name == measure & metric_name == "Rate",
           .(year, sex = sex_name, grp = age_name, prop = val / 1e5)]
  if (!nrow(r)) return(NULL)
  r <- merge(r, std_gs, by = c("grp", "sex"))
  r[, .(rate = sum(prop * std) / std_total * per), by = year][year >= 2000][order(year)]
}
ha_inc   <- gbd_asr_yr(CAUSE,        "Incidence",  1000)
ha_prev  <- gbd_asr_yr(CAUSE,        "Prevalence", 1000)
ha_rhdmx <- gbd_asr_yr(CAUSE,        "Deaths",     1e5)
ha_allmx <- gbd_asr_yr("All causes", "Deaths",     1e5)

combine_series <- function(hist_dt, hist_val, mod_dt, mod_val) {
  parts <- list()
  if (!is.null(hist_dt))
    parts[[1]] <- data.table(year = hist_dt$year, value = hist_dt[[hist_val]], period = "Historical (GBD)")
  parts[[length(parts) + 1]] <- data.table(year = mod_dt$year, value = mod_dt[[mod_val]], period = "Projected (model)")
  out <- rbindlist(parts)
  out[, period := factor(period, levels = c("Historical (GBD)", "Projected (model)"))]
  out[]
}
lt_vals <- c("Historical (GBD)" = "solid", "Projected (model)" = "dashed")
plot_series <- function(dt, title, subtitle, ylab, color, ylab_comma = TRUE) {
  p <- ggplot(dt, aes(year, value, linetype = period)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, color = color) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = lt_vals, name = NULL) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = "Year", y = ylab) +
    base_theme() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  if (ylab_comma) p <- p + scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, limits = c(0, NA))
  p
}
```

```{r validation-note, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (have_gbd && !is.null(h_prev) && !is.null(h_rhdmx)) {
  m0p <- mod_yr[year == base_year, prev]; g0p <- h_prev[year == max(year), count]
  m0d <- mod_yr[year == base_year, rhd_deaths]; g0d <- h_rhdmx[year == max(year), count]
  m0i <- mod_yr[year == base_year, inc]; g0i <- if (!is.null(h_inc)) h_inc[year == max(year), count] else NA_real_
  gy <- h_prev[year == max(year), year]
  cat(sprintf(
"The model enters %d with the bridge-projected state, not with GBD prevalence. In %d the
reference arm has %s people living with RHD (%s convention), %s RHD deaths and %s incident
cases, which are respectively %s, %s and %s the last GBD values (%d, %s basis). These
comparisons span a %d-year gap and different years, so they indicate continuity rather
than fit. Over the horizon the incidence array declines at %s per year (trend %s), and
prevalence reflects the balance of incidence, remission, progression and death.\n",
    base_year, base_year, fmt_n(m0p), PREV_OBS, fmt_n(m0d), fmt_n(m0i),
    rel_phrase(m0p / g0p), rel_phrase(m0d / g0d), if (is.finite(g0i)) rel_phrase(m0i / g0i) else "not comparable with",
    gy, gbd_basis_label, base_year - gy,
    fmt_pct(1 - bstate$meta$incidence_trend, 1), fmt_f(bstate$meta$incidence_trend, 3)))
} else {
  cat("GBD historical artifact unavailable — historical overlays were skipped and",
      "the panels above show the model-projected reference series only.")
}
```

## Age- and sex-specific profiles (every 10 years, 2000–`r year_max`)

Years before `r base_year` are GBD age-group rates; years from `r base_year` on
are the model reference arm folded into the same GBD age groups.

```{r age-profiles, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=7.5}
dec_years <- seq(2000, year_max, by = 10)
refg <- copy(ref)
refg[, grp := age_to_grp(age)]
mod_prof <- refg[, .(prev = sum(prev_obs), dead = sum(dead), pop = sum(pop)), by = .(year, sex, grp)]
mod_prof[, `:=`(prev_rate = prev / pop * 1000, mort = dead / pop * 1e5)]
mod_prof <- mod_prof[year %in% dec_years]
if (have_gbd) {
  g_prev <- gbd[cause_name == CAUSE & measure_name == "Prevalence" & metric_name == "Rate",
                .(year, sex = sex_name, grp = age_name, prev_rate = val / 100)]
  g_mort <- gbd[cause_name == CAUSE & measure_name == "Deaths" & metric_name == "Rate",
                .(year, sex = sex_name, grp = age_name, mort = val)]
  g_prev <- g_prev[year %in% dec_years]; g_mort <- g_mort[year %in% dec_years]
} else {
  g_prev <- g_mort <- NULL
}
build_profile <- function(mod_col, gbd_dt, gbd_col) {
  parts <- list(mod_prof[, .(year, sex, grp, value = get(mod_col))][year >= base_year])
  if (!is.null(gbd_dt))
    parts <- c(list(gbd_dt[year < base_year, .(year, sex, grp, value = get(gbd_col))]), parts)
  out <- rbindlist(parts)
  out <- out[grp %in% names(grp_mid)]
  out[, age_mid := grp_mid[grp]]
  out[, sex := factor(sex, levels = names(sex_cols))]
  out[order(year, sex, age_mid)]
}
prof_prev <- build_profile("prev_rate", g_prev, "prev_rate")
prof_mort <- build_profile("mort",      g_mort, "mort")
ggplot(prof_prev, aes(age_mid, value, color = sex)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ year, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = sex_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "RHD prevalence by age and sex, every 10 years",
       subtitle = paste0("Prevalent cases per 1,000; GBD (before ", base_year, ") and model reference arm (", base_year, "+)"),
       x = "Age (years)", y = "Prevalent cases per 1,000") +
  base_theme(12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r age-profiles-mort, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=7.5}
ggplot(prof_mort, aes(age_mid, value, color = sex)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ year, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = sex_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "RHD mortality rate by age and sex, every 10 years",
       subtitle = paste0("RHD deaths per 100,000; GBD (before ", base_year, ") and model reference arm (", base_year,
                         "+). ", if (death_floor > 0) paste0("Model childhood deaths are low by construction (see calibration).") else ""),
       x = "Age (years)", y = "RHD deaths per 100,000") +
  base_theme(12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Results / outputs {#results}

The headline outputs contrast the two arms for **incident RHD** (a flow),
**prevalent RHD** (the end-of-year stock) and **RHD deaths** (a flow): absolute
values per year (both arms) on top, and the relative difference in the rate
(reference − scale-up, as % of reference) below.

```{r results-compute, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
by_scn <- wsd[, .(inc = sum(newcases), prev = sum(sick), deaths = sum(dead),
                  pop = sum(pop)), by = .(scenario, year)]
by_scn[, `:=`(inc_rate = inc / pop * 1000, prev_rate = prev / pop * 1000,
              mort_rate = deaths / pop * 1e5)]
w2 <- dcast(by_scn, year ~ scenario,
            value.var = c("inc", "prev", "deaths", "inc_rate", "prev_rate", "mort_rate"))
w2[, `:=`(
  red_inc    = inc_ref - inc_sap,
  red_prev   = prev_ref - prev_sap,
  red_deaths = deaths_ref - deaths_sap,
  pct_inc    = fifelse(inc_rate_ref > 0,  (inc_rate_ref - inc_rate_sap)   / inc_rate_ref  * 100, NA_real_),
  pct_prev   = fifelse(prev_rate_ref > 0, (prev_rate_ref - prev_rate_sap) / prev_rate_ref * 100, NA_real_),
  pct_deaths = fifelse(mort_rate_ref > 0, (mort_rate_ref - mort_rate_sap) / mort_rate_ref * 100, NA_real_))]
oc_levels <- c("Incident RHD", "Prevalent RHD (end-of-year stock)", "RHD deaths")
```

## Figure — two-row impact panel (reference vs SAP scale-up)

```{r fig-lancet, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
abs_long <- rbindlist(list(
  by_scn[, .(year, outcome = oc_levels[1], value = inc,    series = as.character(scenario))],
  by_scn[, .(year, outcome = oc_levels[2], value = prev,   series = as.character(scenario))],
  by_scn[, .(year, outcome = oc_levels[3], value = deaths, series = as.character(scenario))]))
abs_long[, row := "Absolute (n / year; stock at year end)"]
pct_long <- rbindlist(list(
  w2[, .(year, outcome = oc_levels[1], value = pct_inc)],
  w2[, .(year, outcome = oc_levels[2], value = pct_prev)],
  w2[, .(year, outcome = oc_levels[3], value = pct_deaths)]))
pct_long[, `:=`(series = "reduction", row = "Reduction in rate vs reference (%)")]
combo <- rbind(abs_long, pct_long)
combo[, outcome := factor(outcome, levels = oc_levels)]
combo[, series  := factor(series, levels = c("ref", "sap", "reduction"))]
panel_lv <- c(paste0(oc_levels, "\n", abs_long$row[1]), paste0(oc_levels, "\n", pct_long$row[1]))
combo[, panel := factor(paste0(outcome, "\n", row), levels = panel_lv)]
col_series <- c(ref = scenario_cols[["ref"]], sap = scenario_cols[["sap"]], reduction = reduction_col)
lab_series <- c(ref = "Reference", sap = "SAP scale-up", reduction = "Reduction in rate, (ref - sap) / ref")
ggplot(combo[year >= base_year & is.finite(value)], aes(year, value, color = series)) +
  geom_hline(data = combo[grepl("%", panel), .(panel = unique(panel))], aes(yintercept = 0),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_series, labels = lab_series, name = NULL, breaks = c("ref", "sap", "reduction")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Projected RHD impact: reference vs SAP scale-up",
       subtitle = paste0("Top: annual flows and year-end stock (both arms). Bottom: reduction in the rate (%; negative = higher under scale-up). ",
                         loc1, ", ", proj_years),
       x = "Year", y = NULL) +
  base_theme(12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r results-interpretation, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
first_eff <- w2[abs(red_deaths) > 1e-6, suppressWarnings(min(year))]
red_d_end <- w2[year == year_max, red_deaths]; pct_d_end <- w2[year == year_max, pct_deaths]
peak_y <- w2[which.max(red_deaths), year]
neg_years <- w2[red_deaths < -1e-6, .N]
inc_diff <- inc_sap_cum - inc_ref_cum
inc_txt <- if (abs(inc_diff) < 0.5) "identical in the two arms" else
  sprintf("%s under the scale-up (%s cases, %s of the reference total)",
          if (inc_diff > 0) "higher" else "lower", fmt_n(abs(inc_diff)), fmt_pct(abs(inc_diff) / inc_ref_cum, 3))
prev_txt <- chg_phrase(prev_end_sap, prev_end_ref, 2)
cat(sprintf(
"**Deaths.** RHD deaths are identical in the two arms until the scale-up first changes
them in **%s**; by %d the scale-up has %s annual RHD deaths (an RHD death rate %s), the largest annual difference occurs in %d, and %s within the horizon show
more deaths under the scale-up. Cumulatively, %s RHD deaths are averted within %s
(%s of reference-arm deaths). %s\n\n",
  if (is.finite(first_eff)) first_eff else "no year", year_max,
  if (red_d_end >= 0) sprintf("%s fewer", fmt_n(red_d_end)) else sprintf("%s more", fmt_n(-red_d_end)),
  w2[year == year_max, chg_phrase(mort_rate_sap, mort_rate_ref)], peak_y,
  if (neg_years == 0) "no years" else sprintf("%d year(s)", neg_years),
  fmt_n(deaths_averted_cum), proj_years, fmt_pct(rel_deaths_cum, 1),
  if (PROG) "Because SAP acts on progression, the mortality effect lags coverage: fewer people enter stage D, and only stage-D deaths respond." else ""))
cat(sprintf(
"**Incidence.** SAP has no direct effect on the incidence hazard (`eff_ir` = 1), yet
cumulative incident cases are %s, because the susceptible pool $W_t = P_t - S_t$
depends on the RHD stock of each arm.\n\n", inc_txt))
cat(sprintf(
"**Prevalence.** At the end of %d the prevalent RHD stock is %s under the scale-up
(%s vs %s people). Stage composition changes as well (below). No probabilistic
uncertainty bands are shown: the pipeline is deterministic and no probabilistic
sensitivity analysis has been run.\n", year_max, prev_txt, fmt_n(prev_end_sap), fmt_n(prev_end_ref)))
```

Surgery is a **clinical service**: each year a fixed fraction of the stage C and
D stocks requiring surgery is operated on at the prevailing coverage. The volume
enters the cost model and reduces C → D progression and stage-D death; it never
removes anyone from a stage.

```{r fig-surgery-trace, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=4}

surg_cmp <- surg_ty[, .(tot = sum(surgeries_C + surgeries_D)), by = scenario]
surg_lg <- melt(surg_ty, id.vars = c("scenario", "year"), measure.vars = c("surgeries_C", "surgeries_D"),
                variable.name = "stage", value.name = "n")
surg_lg[, stage := factor(fifelse(stage == "surgeries_C", "C", "D"), levels = c("C", "D"))]
ggplot(surg_lg[year >= base_year], aes(year, n, fill = stage)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.9, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ scenario, labeller = as_labeller(scenario_labels_short)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(C = stage_cols[["C"]], D = stage_cols[["D"]]),
                    labels = c(C = "Surgeries in stage C", D = "Surgeries in stage D"), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Surgical volume delivered per year (a service, not a state)",
       subtitle = paste0("Coverage is identical in both arms; cumulative volume under the scale-up is ",
                         chg_phrase(surg_cmp[scenario == "sap", tot], surg_cmp[scenario == "ref", tot]),
                         " because the C and D stocks differ"),
       x = "Year", y = "Surgeries delivered per year") +
  base_theme() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

---

# Economic evaluation {#economic-evaluation}

All economics are produced by `08_economic_evaluation.R` and read here from
`rhd_economic_results.rds` (`$summary`, `$budget_impact`, `$incremental`,
`$params`); the consistency checks above confirm that its deaths and costs were
computed from this model run. Costs are applied to the model's volumes —
**echo screening** on the annual screening encounters
([programme volumes](#programme-volumes)), **SAP** on the delivered SAP
person-years (prevalent RHD × SAP coverage), and **surgery** on the annual
surgery trace; diagnosis is counted but carries no unit cost, and incidence is
not costed:
$c_{\text{screen}} = \sum n_{\text{screened}}\times \text{cost}_{\text{screen}}$,
$c_{\text{sap}} = \sum n_{\text{on optimal treatment}}\times \text{cost}_{\text{sap}}$,
$c_{\text{surgery}} = \sum n_{\text{surgeries}}\times \text{cost}_{\text{surgery}}$.
Each component is counted once, and costing is **incremental**
($\text{cost}(\text{sap}) - \text{cost}(\text{ref})$), not gross programme cost.

## Method and discounting

```{r econ-method, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
b_yr <- eparams$gni_pc_base_year
cat(sprintf(
"Costs and benefits are **discounted at %s per year** to a base year of **%d**
with discount factor $\\text{df}_t = (1+r)^{-(t-%d)}$, $r=%s$. Annual incremental
cost is $\\text{cost}(\\text{sap}) - \\text{cost}(\\text{ref})$. Annual RHD
**deaths averted** ($\\text{ref}-\\text{sap}$, kept signed: a year with more deaths
under the scale-up enters with a negative value) are monetised with the **value of a
statistical life (VSL) alone**. VSL is anchored on **GNI per capita** in the income
anchor year $b = %d$ and carried forward with the GDP-per-capita growth path (unit income
elasticity over time):
$$
\\text{VSL}_b = m \\times \\text{GNIpc}_b = %g \\times %s = %s\\ \\text{US dollars},\\qquad
\\text{VSL}_t = \\text{VSL}_b\\,\\frac{\\text{GDPpc}_t}{\\text{GDPpc}_b} = \\text{VSL}_b\\,(1+g)^{\\,t-b},\\quad g = %s,
$$
$$
\\text{benefit}_t = \\text{deaths averted}_t \\times \\text{VSL}_t .
$$
GNI per capita is %s. GDP per capita serves only as the growth index (its level cancels
in the ratio), and $g$ is a constant real per-capita growth **scenario assumption**, not an
external forecast. VSL is therefore in constant %d US dollars; the price year of the unit costs is
not recorded in the pipeline. The multiple $m = %g$ is **provisional**: it is retained from
the former VSL = %g × GDP-per-capita specification and now applied to GNI per capita. The
former additive one-year GDP-per-capita benefit is **removed** (the saved `benefit_gdp`
column is a retired compatibility field, identically zero). The valuation is **per RHD
death averted within the horizon**; it is not a life-year, QALY or lifetime-welfare
valuation. **Cost per DALY averted** divides discounted cost by discounted deaths averted
times a fixed %g DALYs per death (a deaths-only approximation: no years lived with
disability and no age-specific life expectancy), and **cost per death averted** divides
discounted cost by *undiscounted* deaths averted.",
  fmt_pct(eparams$disc_rate, 1), disc_base, disc_base, fmt_f(eparams$disc_rate, 3),
  b_yr, eparams$vsl_mult, gsub(",", "{,}", fmt_n(eparams$gni_pc_base)), gsub(",", "{,}", fmt_n(vsl_b)), fmt_f(eparams$gdp_growth, 3),
  no_dollar(eparams$gni_pc_source), b_yr, eparams$vsl_mult, eparams$vsl_mult, eparams$dalys_per_death))
```

$$
\text{BCR} = \frac{\sum_t \text{df}_t\,\text{deaths\_averted}_t\,\text{VSL}_t}{\sum_t \text{df}_t\,\text{inc\_cost}_t}
\quad\big(\text{defined only when the denominator is positive}\big),
\qquad
\text{net benefit} = \sum_t \text{df}_t\,(\text{benefit}_t - \text{inc\_cost}_t),
$$
$$
\text{cost/DALY} = \frac{\sum_t \text{df}_t\,\text{inc\_cost}_t}{\big(\sum_t \text{df}_t\,\text{deaths\_averted}_t\big)\times \text{DALYs/death}} .
$$

When the discounted incremental cost is zero or negative the ratio is reported as
**undefined** and the outcome is labelled cost-neutral or cost-saving
(`incremental_cost_status` in the saved summary); no positive denominator is
substituted. The TOTAL row pools benefits and costs across locations rather than
averaging location ratios.

## Economic summary

```{r tbl-econ-summary, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
es <- copy(econ_sum)
ratio_or_na <- function(x, ok, f) ifelse(ok & is.finite(x), f(x), "not defined")
es_disp <- data.table(
  Location = es$location,
  `Incremental cost` = vapply(es$total_cost, usd_m, character(1)),
  `Monetised benefit` = vapply(es$total_benefit, usd_m, character(1)),
  `Net benefit` = vapply(es$net_benefit, usd_m, character(1)),
  BCR = ratio_or_na(es$bcr, es$total_cost > 0, function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2)),
  `Deaths averted (undiscounted)` = fmt_n(es$deaths_averted, 0),
  `Cost / death averted` = ratio_or_na(es$cost_per_death, es$deaths_averted > 0, function(x) vapply(x, fmt_usd, "")),
  `Cost / DALY averted` = ratio_or_na(es$cost_per_daly, es$deaths_averted > 0, function(x) vapply(x, fmt_usd, "")))
kbl_e <- kable(es_disp,
      caption = paste0("Table 7. Economic summary (discounted to ", disc_base, " unless stated; US$). ",
                       "Rows as saved by 08; TOTAL pools all locations."),
      align = c("l", rep("r", 7))) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE, font_size = 12) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
tot_row <- which(es$location == "TOTAL")
if (length(tot_row)) kbl_e <- row_spec(kbl_e, tot_row, bold = TRUE, background = "#eef2f7")
footnote(kbl_e, general = paste0(
  "Benefit = deaths averted × VSL only (", eparams$vsl_mult, " × GNI per capita in ", eparams$gni_pc_base_year,
  ", grown with GDP per capita), discounted at ", fmt_pct(eparams$disc_rate, 1),
  " to ", disc_base, ". Cost/DALY uses ", eparams$dalys_per_death, " DALYs per RHD death (deaths only). ",
  "BCR is not defined when discounted incremental cost is not positive."))
```

## What the revision changed: screening costing versus valuation

```{r tbl-bridge, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
bd <- bridge[, .(Specification, `Incremental cost (PV)` = vapply(cost, usd_m, ""),
                 `Monetised benefit (PV)` = vapply(benefit, usd_m, ""), `Net benefit (PV)` = vapply(net, usd_m, ""),
                 BCR = ifelse(is.finite(bcr), fmt_f(bcr), "not defined"))]
kable(bd, caption = paste0("Table 8. Revision bridge (", loc1, "; discounted to ", disc_base,
                           "). Retired definitions recomputed from the saved run; health results are identical in every row."),
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE, font_size = 12) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |> row_spec(4, bold = TRUE, background = "#eef2f7") |>
  footnote(general = paste0(
    "Retired screening volume = screening reach × whole population (all ages) every year; retired valuation = deaths averted × (",
    eparams$vsl_mult, " + 1) × GDP per capita (", fmt_usd(eparams$gdp_pc_base), " in ", eparams$gdp_pc_base_year,
    ", grown at ", fmt_pct(eparams$gdp_growth, 1), "). The first row reproduces the economics saved before this revision."))
```

```{r bridge-text, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
bv <- setNames(bridge$bcr, bridge$row_id)
cat(sprintf(
"**Screening correction.** Pricing screening per scheduled encounter instead of for the whole
population every year %s the discounted incremental screening cost from %s to %s. Holding
benefits fixed, a lower but still positive incremental cost can only raise the ratio: on its
own the correction %s the BCR from %s to %s. This reflects cheaper programme delivery, **not**
greater biological effectiveness — deaths averted are identical in every row.\n\n",
  if (scr_pv[["new"]] < scr_pv[["old"]]) "cuts" else "changes",
  usd_m(scr_pv[["old"]]), usd_m(scr_pv[["new"]]), dir_word(bv[["screen"]], bv[["prev"]]),
  fmt_f(bv[["prev"]]), fmt_f(bv[["screen"]])))
cat(sprintf(
"**Valuation correction.** Valuing each death averted at VSL alone, anchored on GNI per capita
(%s in %d) rather than VSL plus one year of GDP per capita on GDP per capita (%s in %d), changes
the discounted benefit from %s to %s; on its own it %s the BCR from %s to %s.\n\n",
  fmt_usd(eparams$gni_pc_base), eparams$gni_pc_base_year, fmt_usd(eparams$gdp_pc_base), eparams$gdp_pc_base_year,
  usd_m(pvb_old), usd_m(pvb_new), dir_word(bv[["value"]], bv[["prev"]]), fmt_f(bv[["prev"]]), fmt_f(bv[["value"]])))
cat(sprintf(
"**Combined.** With both corrections the saved BCR is **%s**, so the revision as a whole %s the
ratio relative to the retired definitions (%s).\n\n",
  if (is.finite(bv[["both"]])) fmt_f(bv[["both"]]) else "not defined", dir_word(bv[["both"]], bv[["prev"]]), fmt_f(bv[["prev"]])))
```

## Budget impact

```{r tbl-budget, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
show_years <- intersect(seq(base_year, year_max, by = 10), budget$year)
bshow <- budget[year %in% show_years,
                .(Year = year, `Cost — reference` = cost_ref, `Cost — SAP scale-up` = cost_sap,
                  `Incremental cost` = incremental, `Deaths averted` = deaths_avert)]
for (cc in c("Cost — reference", "Cost — SAP scale-up", "Incremental cost"))
  bshow[, (cc) := vapply(get(cc), usd_m, character(1))]
bshow[, `Deaths averted` := fmt_n(`Deaths averted`, 0)]
kable(bshow,
      caption = "Table 9. Budget impact at decade years (undiscounted annual programme cost by arm, incremental cost, and RHD deaths averted).",
      align = c("l", rep("r", 4))) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE, font_size = 12) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

```{r dt-budget, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
bdt <- budget[, .(Year = year, `Cost ref` = round(cost_ref), `Cost sap` = round(cost_sap),
                  `Incremental` = round(incremental), `Deaths averted` = round(deaths_avert, 1),
                  `Screen` = round(c_screen), `SAP` = round(c_sap), `Surgery` = round(c_surgery))]
datatable(bdt, rownames = FALSE,
          caption = paste0("Full annual budget-impact table (", proj_years,
                           "). Cost columns in US$ (undiscounted); Screen/SAP/Surgery are the SAP-arm component costs."),
          options = list(pageLength = 12, scrollX = TRUE, order = list(list(0, "asc")))) |>
  formatCurrency(c("Cost ref", "Cost sap", "Incremental", "Screen", "SAP", "Surgery"), currency = "$", digits = 0) |>
  formatRound("Deaths averted", digits = 1)
```

## Figure 3 — Cost of interventions scaled to target coverage, by source

```{r fig3-cost-by-source, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=5}
cost_src <- melt(budget[, .(year, c_screen, c_sap, c_surgery)], id.vars = "year",
                 variable.name = "component", value.name = "cost")
comp_lab <- c(c_screen = "Echo screening", c_sap = "Secondary prophylaxis (SAP)", c_surgery = "Valve surgery")
comp_col <- c(c_screen = "#4E79A7", c_sap = "#F28E2B", c_surgery = "#E15759")
cost_src[, component := factor(component, levels = names(comp_lab))]
ggplot(cost_src, aes(year, cost / 1e6, fill = component)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.9, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = ramp_start, xmax = ramp_end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.06, fill = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = comp_col, labels = comp_lab, name = "Cost component") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Figure 3. Cost of the SAP scale-up arm, by source",
       subtitle = paste0("SAP-arm annual programme cost (US$ millions, undiscounted) by component; shaded = ramp (",
                         ramp_start, "–", ramp_end, ")"),
       x = "Year", y = "Annual cost (US$ millions)",
       caption = "Components are the SAP-arm totals saved in rhd_budget_impact; they sum to the SAP-arm total cost.") +
  base_theme() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Benefit versus cost, and net benefit over time

```{r fig-benefit-cost, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
ic <- copy(incr)
ic[, `:=`(disc_cost = inc_cost * df, disc_benefit = benefit_total * df)]
bc_long <- rbindlist(list(
  ic[, .(year, value = disc_cost,    stream = "Discounted incremental cost")],
  ic[, .(year, value = disc_benefit, stream = "Discounted monetised benefit")]))
print(ggplot(bc_long, aes(year, value / 1e6, color = stream)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Discounted incremental cost" = "#E15759", "Discounted monetised benefit" = "#59A14F"), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Annual discounted benefit vs cost",
       subtitle = paste0("Discounted to ", disc_base, " at ", fmt_pct(eparams$disc_rate, 1), "; US$ millions"),
       x = "Year", y = "US$ millions (discounted)") +
  base_theme() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))
ic[, cum_net := cumsum((benefit_total - inc_cost) * df)]
be_year <- ic[cum_net >= 0, suppressWarnings(min(year))]
print(ggplot(ic, aes(year, cum_net / 1e9)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "#2166ac") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Cumulative discounted net benefit",
       subtitle = paste0("Running total of (benefit minus cost), discounted; US$ billions. ",
                         if (is.finite(be_year)) paste0("Cumulative net benefit first becomes non-negative in ", be_year, ".")
                         else "Cumulative net benefit stays negative within the horizon."),
       x = "Year", y = "Cumulative net benefit (US$ billions)") +
  base_theme())
```

# Limitations and interpretation

- **Deterministic point estimates.** One deterministic run per arm, with no
  probabilistic or one-way sensitivity analysis, so no uncertainty intervals are
  available; all clinical, efficacy, coverage and economic inputs (Table 1) are
  point values.
- **Provisional structure.** `r if (D_ONLY) "D-only RHD mortality (exact zeros in A–C) is a modelling assumption pending clinical review; the stage-D mortality prior is a pooled workbook proxy, scalar across age and sex." else "All-stage mortality is the legacy structure."`
  `r if (PROG) "SAP acts through progression hazard ratios: two come from a single trial in children under a provisional stage mapping, and the C → D effect is an assumption carried from Coates et al. (2021). The hazard-scale application is a population-average approximation." else ""`
- **Childhood deaths.** `r if (death_floor > 0) sprintf("RHD death targets below age %d are excluded from the loss because the modelled pathway cannot generate them; modelled childhood RHD deaths are far below GBD (see calibration diagnostics). Acute or rapidly fatal childhood disease is not represented.", death_floor) else "All death ages are scored."`
- **Fit and identification.** The saved epidemiological fit status is
  *`r SC$statuses$epidemiological_fit`*.
  `r if (length(SC$bounds$boundary_hits)) paste0("Parameters at a bound: ", paste(SC$bounds$boundary_hits, collapse = ", "), ". ") else ""`GBD
  gives only total prevalence and deaths, so the stage split is partially
  identified; the identifiability sweep and near-optimal sets are not posterior
  intervals or proof of joint identification.
- **Adult extrapolation.** Transition evidence is mainly from children and
  adolescents; the adult hazard multipliers are determined by the GBD age
  pattern, not by adult cohort data.
- **Horizon-bounded deaths averted.** Deaths averted are counted within
  `r proj_years`; some may be deferred beyond the horizon rather than prevented.
- **Background mortality and population.** Background mortality is held at its
  `r BASE_YEAR` GBD pattern over the horizon while WPP population changes; the
  No-RHD pool absorbs differences between the population sources.
- **Surgery as a population-average service.** Surgery reduces C → D and
  stage-D death in proportion to coverage; operative mortality and post-surgical
  states are not modelled. Surgery coverage is equal in both arms.
- **Screening schedule.** The screening windows (ages
  `r paste(sprintf("%d–%d", sched$age_lo, sched$age_hi), collapse = " and ")`) and
  frequencies (`r paste(sprintf("%g", sched$n_screens), collapse = " and ")` screens
  per window) are scenario assumptions; only the 5–19 window is supported by the
  WHO 2024 guideline. Encounters are expected annual volumes of a programme
  spread evenly across each window, not individual screening histories or unique
  people screened. Screening reach also caps SAP coverage through a simplifying
  reach ceiling; this is not a measured care cascade.
- **SAP eligibility.** SAP volume is prevalent RHD × coverage: guideline-specific
  eligibility (by stage and age), prophylaxis duration, initiation and
  discontinuation, and retention states are not modelled, and clinical diagnosis
  outside screening is subsumed in the provisional coverage.
- **Economic assumptions.** The benefit uses VSL alone, at
  `r eparams$vsl_mult`× GNI per capita (`r eparams$gni_pc_base_year`) grown with a
  constant real GDP-per-capita growth assumption; the multiple is provisional
  (carried over from the former GDP-based specification). Unit-cost sources and
  price year are not recorded in the pipeline; diagnosis is not costed. Cost per
  DALY uses a fixed `r eparams$dalys_per_death` DALYs per death (deaths only, no
  years lived with disability, not age-specific).
- **Historical validation basis.** GBD series are shown on the calibration
  target basis (`r gbd_basis_label`); age standardisation to a single reference
  year cannot capture within-age-group composition changes.
